jobs.description:
Über Atos

Atos ist die Marke der Atos Group für KI-gestützte, sichere und ganzheitliche digitale Services. Atos entwirft, entwickelt und betreibt kritische digitale Umgebungen, die Leistungsfähigkeit, Ausfallsicherheit und Souveränität fördern. So unterstützt Atos öffentliche und private Organisationen weltweit dabei, die Kontrolle über ihre Daten und IT-Infrastrukturen zu bewahren und gleichzeitig regulatorische Anforderungen zu erfüllen.

Mit mehr als 54.000 Mitarbeitenden betreut Atos über 4.500 Kunden in 54 Ländern, und unterstützt sie bei der Modernisierung ihrer zentralen IT-Systeme, der Beschleunigung ihrer Cloud- und Datentransformation, der Stärkung ihrer Cybersicherheit sowie der Bereitstellung sicherer digitaler Arbeitsplatzlösungen – zum Nutzen seiner Kunden, ihrer Mitarbeitenden und der Gesellschaft. Darüber hinaus bietet Atos unter der Marke Atos Amplify Beratungsleistungen an.

Als vertrauenswürdiger Partner beim Betrieb komplexer und geschäftskritischer Umgebungen unterstützt Atos Organisationen in stark regulierten und souveränen Kontexten.

Über die Atos Group

Die Atos Group ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter im Bereich der digitalen Transformation. Mit ca. 56.000 Mitarbeitenden und einem Jahresumsatz von ca. 7,2 Mrd. EUR (auf Basis des künftigen Unternehmenszuschnitts) agiert das Unternehmen in 54 Ländern unter zwei Marken Atos für Services und Eviden für Produkte und Systeme. Als europäische Nummer eins in der Cybersicherheit und führend im Bereich Cloud arbeitet die Atos Group für eine sichere und dekarbonisierte Zukunft und bietet maßgeschneiderte KI-gestützte End-to-End Lösungen für alle Branchen. Atos Group ist an der Euronext Paris notiert.

Wir suchen neue Kolleg innen an unseren bundesweiten Standorten
.

Unser SAP-Team besteht im deutschsprachigen Raum aus langjährig erfahrenen SAP-Beratern, die branchenübergreifend Transformationsprojekte und -programme im SAP S4/ HANA Umfeld planen, umsetzen und betreiben. Als Senior Project Manager verantworten Sie die vertragliche und fachliche Führung unserer SAP-Projekte und steuern unsere internationalen Projektteams. In dieser Rolle sind Sie verantwortlich für das Erreichen der Projektziele, den Projekterfolg und die Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden.

Das sind Ihre Aufgaben

Sie sind Partner des Kunden bei der Definition und Implementierung seiner Geschäftsstrategien in Bezug auf Prozesse und IT und deren Umsetzung in den nationalen und internationalen Konzernorganisationen, insbesondere auch in Bezug auf die nachhaltige Etablierung von Prozess- und IT-Governance Strukturen
Sie haben die unternehmerische Verantwortung für die fachliche Führung großer SAP-Programme und Projektteams oder Teilprojekte in einem Multiprojekt-Umfeld (> 50 Teammitglieder)
Sie tragen die Verantwortung für das Erreichen der Projektziele in Zeit, Budget und Qualität, den Projekterfolg und die Zufriedenheit des Kunden in Projekten mit einem Volumen von bis zu 30 Mio. €
Sie übernehmen die Planung, Leitung und Ressourcensteuerung von internationalen und multidisziplinären (Technologien, Organisationen), internen oder externen Projekten mit Profit & Loss Verantwortung für das Projekt mit umfassend definiertem und dokumentiertem Leistungsumfang in Bezug auf Rollout, Transition, Transformation und Entwicklung unter Einhaltung vorgegebener Prozesse und Methoden
Monitoring des Projektfortschritts, Erstellung von Statusberichten, Prüfung und Überwachung definierter Projektkennzahlen in allen Phasen des Projektes sowie Dokumentation vorhandener Projektergebnisse und -erfahrungen, Nachbetrachtung und / oder Lessons Learned zu Projektabschluss gehören ebenfalls zu Ihren Aufgaben

Das bringen Sie mit

Abgeschlossenes Studium in der Fachrichtung Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung
Sie verfügen über mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung im Projektgeschäft und überzeugen durch profundes fachliches Know-how in der Konsolidierung und Harmonisierung von Geschäftsprozessen und IT-Applikationen im SAP ERP-Umfeld
Sie kennen SAP S/4HANA und die weiteren SAP-Technologien in der Digital Supply Chain, im CRM und Analytics-Umfeld und verstehen das Zusammenspiel der Komponenten.Die besonderen Herausforderungen und Clean-Core-Anforderungen bei Private Cloud und Public Cloud Implementierungen haben Sie idealerweise schon kennengelernt.
Sie verfügen über eine PMP-Zertifizierung oder Vergleichbares und besitzen sehr gute Kenntnisse der gängigen Beratungs- und Projektmanagement-Methoden und -Tools, speziell im SAP-Umfeld. Insbesondere sind sie mit SAP Activate als Methodik für S/4 HANA-Implementierungen vertraut. Auch haben Sie sich schon mit agilen Projektvorgehensweisen wie z. B. SCRUM beschäftigt und idealerweise in ihren Projekten eingesetzt
Sie haben Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung von Teams
Die Umsetzung von strategischen Konzepten ihrer Kunden gehört genauso zu ihren Erfahrungen wie das Erkennen von Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und deren Umsetzung in Neugeschäft
Ausgeprägte Präsentationsfähigkeiten, Verhandlungsgeschick sowie Prozesswissen und Branchen Know-how (z. B. Manufacturing, Telecommunication, Energy, Electronic, Healthcare) sind für diese Aufgabe genauso wichtig, wie Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Kundenorientierung und Erfahrung in der Vertragsgestaltung
Mit Ihren verhandlungssicheren Deutsch- und Englischkenntnissen sind Sie ein kompetenter Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden

jobs.description:
You’ll be responsible for leading and managing projects, directing and coordinating the activities of multiple disciplines on a project of moderate scope or a combination of smaller projects. You’ll also work with great people and have a good time doing it.

Who We Are

We’re a people-first organization. We value knowledge and learning. We believe in the power of connection and collaboration and we seek to build relationships that mean something. We employ some of the best and brightest in the industry and we work hard to maintain a culture that our people can be proud of.

WORKING FOR PRIMERA

Our Utilities division is a talented team of experts working together to provide solutions that are vital to energizing our future. We provide full-service electrical, civil, and structural engineering services to support electric and gas utilities nationwide. We’re also fortunate to support wind farms and renewables; transmissions systems; and university and industrial facilities.

Who You Are

You’re a leader in the project or program management arena. You’re able to effectively manage projects and coordinate lead discipline engineers and architects. Highly-motivated with at least 5-10 years of experience in the engineering, design, or construction fields, you’re knowledgeable of utility industry standard practices and requirements.
Your qualifications and experience are impressive. You have direct experience working with utilities on power delivery projects and understand the overall design and project delivery process. You have a bachelor’s degree in a related field. A graduate degree and/or professional certifications may be substituted for our experience requirements. A PMP certification will definitely help you stand out.
You are proficient with business and engineering applications. Microsoft Office and Project proficiency and an understanding of CAD methods and procedures are a must.
You’re a people person. You have a positive attitude and enjoy developing relationships with staff and clients alike. You enjoy leading and mentoring people and have the ability to properly delegate. Your strong organization and communication skills will contribute to your success.

What You’ll Do

You’ll be responsible for leading and managing projects. You’ll direct and coordinate the activities of multiple disciplines on a project of moderate scope or a combination of smaller projects. You’ll assist with project planning and establishing critical milestones and objectives. You’ll manage the project delivery and submittal of project deliverables and ensure your projects are completed on schedule and under budget. You’ll also aid in the review and execution of project agreements and initiate or assist in contract negotiations or preparation.
You’ll have a hand in Marketing. You’ll help set and meet marketing objectives, aid in business development efforts, and actively participate in the proposal process.
You’ll connect with people, both internally and externally. We believe it’s what sets us apart. You’ll solicit, develop and maintain client and sub-consultant relationships to help us deliver best-in-class customer service.
You’ll enhance and protect our reputation. You’ll represent Primera at client meetings and ensure that Primera’s management systems and processes are followed and continually improved. You will act promptly to identify and manage risks and opportunities in achieving client satisfaction.
You’ll enjoy what you do. You’ll work with great people, continue to learn and grow, and have a good time doing it.

Some Of What You’ll Enjoy

An excellent benefits package including 401K match and employee stock ownership, gym and transit subsidies, paid volunteer time off, parental leave, continuing education reimbursement and much more
Flexible work scheduling in a fast-growing company
Colleagues that appreciate differences in people, perspectives, cultures, and ideas
The fruits of our employee-led committees focused on offering engaging social, wellness and community service activities all year long

As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?

Watch Our Story:' https://www.hdrinc.com/our-story'

Each and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.

We believe electricity powers modern life. As part of our Power sector, you’ll help shape how electricity is generated, transmitted and delivered as global energy demands grow. From massive data centers to modernizing transmission systems, our industry-recognized engineers and scientists have been at the forefront of grid transformation for more than a century. You’ll work side-by-side with these experts and contribute to reliable, resilient and sustainable power systems, helping communities thrive and industries expand. This isn’t just a job, it’s a chance to drive infrastructure forward, power innovation and leave your mark on our energy future

In the role of Power Delivery EPC Program Manager, we'll count on you to:

Assume leadership responsibilities for managing multidisciplinary infrastructure programs with a high degree of technical complexity and non-technical intricacies.
Advise clients on the technical, regulatory, financial, and community facets of infrastructure programs, which are all critical to program success. Leverage lessons learned from other programs and industry best management practices to address each client's specific needs.
Plan, direct and monitor all aspects of program execution. This may involve overseeing a broad range of disciplines including, but not limited to: capital planning, change management, commissioning/asset onboarding, communications, construction management, cost control/estimating, document management, environmental planning/compliance, engineering, equity, financial support, organizational strengthening, permitting, planning/design management, program governance, procurement, project management, quality management, real estate, regulatory support, risk management, scheduling, strategic planning, sustainability, and resiliency.
Anticipate and identify potential issues and risks that may impact program implementation, and assist the client with problem-solving, issues resolution, risk mitigation, and timely decision-making. Provide strategic advice and thought leadership and deploy the required resources to address various program challenges and unanticipated events.
Develop and implement various plans (program management plans, startup plans, and work plans), business processes, and tools to drive efficiencies, emphasize accountability, bring team alignment, and promote transparency.
Direct the services provided by a program team comprised of HDR and subconsultants staff. Promote alignment within the team through effective and regular communications. Secure the resources required to deliver services specified in the contract scope with a focus on contract compliance. jobs.title: Senior Program Manager- R&D - Medical Device
jobs.description:
Werfen

Werfen is a growing, family-owned, innovative company founded in 1966 in Barcelona, Spain. We are a worldwide leader in specialized diagnostics in the areas of Hemostasis, Acute Care Diagnostics, Transfusion, Autoimmunity, and Transplant. Through our Original Equipment Manufacturing (OEM) business line, we research, develop, and manufacture customized assays and biomaterials. We operate directly in 30 countries, and in more than 100 territories through distributors. Our Headquarters and Technology Centers are located in the US and Europe, and our workforce is more than 7,000 strong.

Our success comes from a specific focus in these rapidly evolving diagnostic areas, our commitment to customers, and our dedication to innovation and quality. We’re passionate about providing healthcare professionals the most valuable and complete solutions to improve hospital efficiency and enhance patient care.

Overview

Job Summary:

Plan and manage a large multi-functional product development project and/or several small multifunctional product development projects simultaneously. The projects may include large multi-functional projects or a combination of hardware, software, and sustaining projects. The position requires strong, enthusiastic leadership skills in a highly technical medical instrument product development environment. Provide direct supervision to program managers and project managers who are responsible for the projects or major subprojects within the program. Participate in business strategic planning representing current projects and implementing the business strategy. The position requires regular interaction with all functions and levels of the organization from R&D scientists and engineers, marketing/sales, quality/regulatory, and operations, through executive management. Directs the program team and project team(s) in a manner to achieve the business results expected. Forecast program results when requested. Seeks guidance on unusual and complex problems whose solution exceeds the approved project or program boundaries. Authority of position is that required to carry out assigned duties, except where expressly reserved by the senior management personnel or Werfen Corporate/Division Policy.

Responsibilities

Key Accountabilities

Essential Functions

Program Leadership: Provide technical and team leadership to one or more large project team(s) or program team(s). This may include directly leading one of the projects. Leadership entails planning, scheduling, assignment of work, and technical support within the program area. Drive the successful attainment of program goals.
Project Planning and Scheduling: Responsible for project or program planning and scheduling, clarifying and defining the scope of work, utilizing deliverable milestone methods and critical path scheduling, conducting resource planning and allocation, and developing task and project estimates. Generates integrated project plans that meet business objectives and are in compliance with the design control process, while maximizing resource efficiency.
Project Execution and Control: Responsible for conducting regular project or program team status meetings and reviews. Ensures deliverables are completed and documented. Identifies the need for and implements changes to the program and project plans that are within approved program and project boundaries. Plan and conduct major program and supporting project and milestone reviews.
Agile Project Management: Participates in the decision-making process regarding when to employ the Agile methodology. Ensure adequate resources are applied to Agile projects.
Problem Solving Leadership: Responsible for coordination of program and project resources to identify the root cause(s) of program and project issues, and develop and manage a plan to fix, test, and implement an appropriate solution through completion.
Risk Management Leadership: Responsible for ensuring program and project risks, both technical risks and management risks, are identified and appropriate risk mitigation plans are included within the program and project plan. Regularly assess and report the status of overall program risk remaining on a program. Identify risk trends and patterns across the program and develop risk mitigation strategies for systemic risks.
Design Control: Creates and maintains file to current phase ensuring accuracy. Ensure compliance with Design Control practices.
Communication: Responsible for program communication for both within the project team(s) and between the team(s) and executive management.
Vendor Management: Responsible for ensuring adequate oversight and control of vendors providing development, test or technical services that support the project.
Cross Department Collaboration: Responsible to establish communication channels with commercial functions, support team and infrastructure to ensure successful on market change(s) and/or new product introduction. Uses input from commercial functions to influence and execute program plan.
Conflict Resolution: Able to resolve program and project team conflict through the application of good listening skills and negotiating skills. Able to remove oneself from the problem. Fosters a creative, professional climate that will maximize the contributions of the technical staff.
Resource Allocation: Ensures that adequate equipment and material resources are available to advance the program and project(s) and achieve goals and objectives. Works with other program and project managers to ensure the best use of shared resources.
Supervision and Employee Performance: Demonstrated functional management expertise and skills in developing, mentoring and coaching others. Works with functional management participating in skills/gap assessments and conducting coaching for project core team members. Provides direct supervision to Program Managers and Project Managers assigned to the program.
Strategy Development: Lead activities focused on improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the product development processes and procedures.

Budget Managed

Prepares and maintains budgets for the portfolio of programs and projects.
Annual budget between $5 million and $10 million

Networking/Key Relationships

Works with functional management to conduct performance appraisals and coaching for project core team members. Provide regular supervision for assigned Project/Program Manager(s).

To be determined based on department and project needs, to include interactions such as:

Coordination of review of documentation with Quality and Regulatory disciplines
Communication of product changes with Manufacturing / Operations disciplines
Communication of plans and status of projects with Marketing discipline
Communication of plans and status with other programs and projects within R&D

Qualifications

Minimum Knowledge & Experience Required for the Position:

BS in STEM or management discipline of MS/MBA
Additional course work in accounting, business economics, strategy development, resource management and project management is desired
At least 10 years of experience, preferably in product development with at least 5 years of successful technical leadership, project coordination, or project management are required
Experience in the development and release of at least one successful product launch of a medical instrumentation product is desirable
Certification in program management is preferred
Full and comprehensive knowledge of the complete product lifecycle, including all aspects of product development from conception to manufacturing introduction

Skills & Capabilities

Leadership
Functional/technical skills
Analytical Skills
Developing direct reports
Problem-solvingng, conflict management, listening, managing and measuring work
Strong project management skill set and familiarity with project management tools and techniques
Team player, self-motivated, perseverance
Strong oral and written skills
Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Design Control

Travel Requirements

Less than 15% of the time.

The annual base salary range for this role is currently $190,000 to $220,000. Individual employee compensation will ultimately depend on factors including education, relevant experience, skillset, knowledge, and particular business needs.

This role is eligible for medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k plan retirement benefits with an employer match, as well as paid vacation and sick leave. Our sales roles are eligible for participation in a commission plan and our management, and select professional roles, are eligible for a performance-based bonus.

Closing

If you are interested in constantly learning and being challenged on a daily basis we encourage you to submit your resume or CV.

Werfen is an Equal Opportunity employer and is committed to a diverse workplace. Werfen strictly prohibits unlawful discrimination, harassment or retaliation based upon an individual’s race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin/ancestry, age, mental/physical disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as defined by applicable state or federal law. If you have a disability and need an accommodation in relation to the online application process, please contact NAtalentacquisition@werfen.com for assistance.

Overview

Jhpiego is an international, non-profit health organisation and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high-quality, low-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems. Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong on-the-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real-world systems across 11 thematic domains (Maternal and Newborn Health, Reproductive Health, Nutrition, Immunisation, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, Human Resources for Health, TB and Infectious Diseases, Global Health Security, Women's Cancers, Non-Communicable Diseases, Digital Health).

Jhpiego will work closely with State Governments across eight identified states to strengthen immunization systems for children and adolescents from birth to 16 years of age. Key focus areas include supporting age-appropriate and timely vaccination, strengthening service delivery, facilitating data-driven planning and monitoring, and supporting capacity development and community engagement to ensure every child and adolescent is protected against vaccine-preventable diseases.

Jhpiego is hiring for the position of Program Manager Officer based at Delhi. The position will work closely with the governments, Jhpiego India country office and state teams for implementation of the project activities. The projects focus on to strengthen immunization system across the birth-to-16-years age group . The position will report to Senior Program Manager, Immunization.

Responsibilities

P lanning, coordination and implementation of project activities across the eight identified states, ensuring alignment with project objectives and approved workplans.
Provide strategic and technical leadership to strengthen routine immunization systems and improve age-appropriate vaccination across the birth-to-16-years age group.
Development and implementation of strategies to identify, track and reach left-out and dropout children and adolescents, with a focus on improving immunization coverage, timeliness and completeness.
Coordinate closely with the Ministry, State Health Departments and other key stakeholders to facilitate effective program implementation and address systemic challenges.
Provide technical guidance and oversight to state-level project teams to ensure quality implementation, timely delivery of activities and achievement of program targets.
Lead stakeholder engagement and facilitate national and state-level consultations, review meetings, technical workshops and capacity-building initiatives with government officials and development partners.
Undertake periodic field visits to project states to review implementation progress, provide strategic guidance and support resolution of program bottlenecks.
Work closely with the MERL team to review program performance, monitor key indicators, analyze data and facilitate evidence-based decision-making and course correction.
Oversee program documentation, including good practices, innovations, implementation experiences, success stories and lessons learned.
Lead the preparation and timely submission of donor reports, program updates, technical presentations, workplans and other project deliverables.
Coordinate with internal teams, including Finance, HR, Operations and MERL, to ensure effective resource utilization, compliance and smooth program implementation.
Contribute to resource mobilization and proposal development by identifying emerging opportunities and providing technical inputs for new immunization initiatives.
Undertake other responsibilities as assigned by the supervisor in support of program objectives.

Required Qualifications

Master’s degree in public health (MPH), Health Management, Community Medicine, Epidemiology or Social Sciences. Candidates with a medical background (MBBS/BDS/BAMS/BHMS) along with a relevant postgraduate qualification will be preferred.
8-10 years of relevant experience in public health, immunization or health systems strengthening programs.
Demonstrated experience in planning, implementation and monitoring of immunization programs preferably at state and district levels.
Experience working closely with government health systems, particularly MoHFW and development partners.
Demonstrated experience in stakeholder coordination, community engagement and working with frontline health workers and community platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

Strong program planning, implementation, coordination and problem-solving skills.
Ability to analyze program data, identify performance gaps and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
Strong stakeholder engagement, interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with government officials, development partners and community stakeholders.
Good documentation, report writing, presentation and knowledge-management skills.
Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, and analyzing data of immunization program.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team.

Willingness to undertake frequent field visits and travel to project states and districts as required

– Identifier les points de blocage (appuis à remplacer, autorisations, approvisionnement en matériel, aléas climatiques) et suivre les plans d'action associés avec les Chefs de Projet.

■ Planification et gestion des ressources

– Construire et tenir à jour le planning global du programme, en intégrant les dépendances entre études, autorisations, travaux et liaisons terrestres et maritimes.

– Suivre la capacité des sous-traitants et des équipes internes, et alerter en cas d'écart entre charge et ressources.

– Anticiper les contraintes logistiques propres à l'insularité : délais d'acheminement du matériel, disponibilité de la main-d'œuvre qualifiée.

■ Gouvernance et reporting

– Produire les tableaux de bord hebdomadaires et mensuels à destination de la direction et des instances de gouvernance.

– Préparer et contribuer au reporting contractuel de la DSP auprès du Conseil départemental, autorité délégante.

– Préparer les comités de pilotage et revues de production, rédiger les comptes rendus et assurer le suivi des décisions.

– Préparer les éléments justificatifs nécessaires au suivi des financements publics (État, FEDER, Département).

■ Suivi budgétaire et contractuel

– Suivre les coûts par prise et par phase, les engagements, les bons de commande et la facturation des prestataires, en lien avec le contrôle de gestion.

– Suivre les jalons et engagements contractuels de la DSP, ainsi que l'application des clauses contractuelles avec les prestataires et partenaires.

– Alerter sur les dérives de coûts ou de délais et proposer des mesures correctives.

■ Qualité des données et amélioration continue

– Garantir la cohérence des données de déploiement entre les outils (SIG, outils de suivi de production, référentiel d'adresses) et le respect des formats d'échange (Grace THD, IPE).

– Contribuer à la fiabilisation de l'adressage et au suivi des déclarations de prises raccordables auprès de l'Arcep et des opérateurs commerciaux.

– Définir, diffuser et faire évoluer les standards de pilotage (modèles, processus, outils) et capitaliser sur les retours d'expérience.

jobs.description:
About Invent

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

Help build Sweden’s next-generation emergency network – and strengthen societal resilience when it matters most.

Capgemini Invent supports the Swedish Civil Defense and Resilience Agency (MCF) in one of the country’s most important telecom transformation programs: SWEN, the Swedish Emergency Network. SWEN is the next generation of Sweden’s national communication system for public safety, civil defense and critical public services – bringing secure, 5G-based mission-critical voice, data and video (MCX) to the organizations that keep society running.

We are looking for a Project Leader who combines structured delivery leadership with a genuine interest in telecom and critical communications. You will lead project workstreams, keep plans, risks and stakeholders aligned, and turn ambitious goals into measurable results.

What you will do:

Plan, lead and follow up project workstreams end to end – scope, schedule, budget, resources and dependencies
Build and maintain project plans, roadmaps and milestones, applying agile, hybrid or traditional delivery methods as appropriate
Identify, track and mitigate risks, issues and dependencies, and bring decisions to the right governance forums
Run steering group and working meetings, and prepare clear status reports and decision material for senior client stakeholders
Coordinate cross-functional teams – client experts, technical specialists, suppliers and Capgemini colleagues – to keep delivery on track
Manage change requests, quality assurance and acceptance of project deliverables
Grow client relationships and coach junior consultants in project management best practice

Your Profile

At least 5 years of experience leading projects or workstreams, gained in areas such as project management, PMO, IT delivery, consulting, business analysis or business transformation
Background from sectors such as IT, telecom, defense, the public sector or other complex, regulated environments
Hands-on experience with project planning, risk and issue management, stakeholder management and status reporting
A relevant university degree in a field such as engineering, business, economics, computer science or information systems, or equivalent experience
Structured, proactive and self-driven, with strong communication skills and the ability to build trust with senior stakeholders
Fluent English, spoken and written
EU citizenship and the ability to pass a security screening, due to client security requirements

Nice to Have

Knowledge of telecommunications or mission-critical communications (MCX), such as public safety networks, LTE/5G or 3GPP MCX standards
A project management certification
Experience from public sector or critical infrastructure programs, or from telecom operators or vendors
Swedish and/or French language skills

No prior experience in mission-critical communications is needed – we will help you build that domain knowledge through onboarding, training and working alongside our experienced specialists.

What You'll Love About Working Here

Contribute to a program of national importance – strengthening the communications that Sweden's emergency services and public safety actors rely on, especially in a crisis
Build expertise in mission-critical communications, a fast-growing field as public safety moves towards secure, broadband and standards-based MCX services
Learn from and collaborate with Capgemini's network of telecom, MCX, cybersecurity and public sector specialists across Capgemini Invent and the Capgemini Group
Take on real responsibility early, with direct exposure to senior client stakeholders and program governance
Develop your project leadership career through learning programs, coaching and a community of experienced project leaders

jobs.description:

. Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Education, Instructional Design, Educational Technology, Business Administration, Communications, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
4 years of experience in program or project management, educational technology integration, or digital learning development.
Experience managing external digital learning agencies, content vendors, or creative suppliers from project scoping through final asset delivery.
Experience building and structuring courses using digital authoring tools (e.g., Evolve Authoring, Articulate 360/Storyline) and deploying digital learning packages (SCORM/xAPI) into enterprise Learning Management Systems (LMS/LXP).

Preferred qualifications:

Master's degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, or a related field.
Deep understanding of adult learning theory (ADDIE, SAM) applied to legal and compliance training.
Managing complex, multi-vendor learning programs from inception through global corporate deployment.
Designing reusable templates and systems balancing strict legal requirements with engaging UX.
Integrating multimedia production and innovative Generative AI tools into learning workflows.
Applying digital accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA) and conducting technical audits.

About The Job

The Risk, Compliance and Integrity (RCI) Education and Awareness team promotes an ethical and compliant culture across Google by creating innovative, accessible, and user-centered learning experiences. Our mission is to empower Googlers and extended workforce members worldwide to understand key legal, regulatory, and policy requirements, transforming complex compliance mandates into engaging, intuitive, and effective digital education.

As a Learning Program Manager, you will serve as the central program manager and technical integration lead for the compliance education content team. In this role, you will operate at the intersection of instructional design, educational technology, and project execution bridging the gap between high-level regulatory expectations and digital course delivery. You will orchestrate end-to-end development roadmaps with leading external digital learning agencies and suppliers, implement scalable course authoring frameworks in tools such as Evolve Authoring, and oversee technical packaging, testing, and deployment into Google's enterprise Learning Management Systems (LMS / Intellum). Furthermore, you will drive the integration of multimedia and AI-assisted learning tools (such as conversational simulations and AI coaching assistants) across our global compliance curricula.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $111000 - $159000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Lead relationships with external agencies, managing roadmaps, budgets, and milestone schedules to ensure timely curriculum delivery.
Establish authoring frameworks, overseeing SCORM/xAPI packaging, LMS deployment, and multimedia integration including Generative AI tools.
Lead instructional reviews, QA testing, and digital accessibility audits (WCAG 2.1 AA) on all supplier deliverables.
Streamline content intake and legal review workflows with SMEs while coordinating asset cataloging and ticket resolution with extended workforce solutions partners.
Partner with data teams to monitor course completions, analyze user feedback, and drive continuous curriculum improvement.

jobs.title: Program Manager - Workplace Modernization & Employee Experience
jobs.description:
Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today’s needs and tomorrow’s next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we’re living in and that we have the power to shape.

Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality.

Sandisk has two facilities recognized by the World Economic Forum as part of the Global Lighthouse Network for advanced 4IR innovations. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward.

Description

The Program Manager - Workplace Modernization & Employee Experience leads to the end-to-end development and delivery of a strategic portfolio of workplace modernization, facilities transformation, employee experience, and sustainability programs. The role converts business and employee needs into prioritized roadmaps, approved business cases, funded programs, and measurable outcomes. It owns program strategy, portfolio governance, capital and operating planning, executive reporting, change adoption, and benefits realization, while IFM partners and other service providers remain accountable for day-to-day facilities operations, maintenance execution, and contracted service delivery.

Essential And Responsibilities

Workplace Modernization & Facilities Transformation
Develop and maintain a multi-year workplace modernization and facilities transformation roadmap aligned with site strategy, growth plans, operational resilience, and employee needs.
Lead modernization programs from concept and feasibility through design, funding approval, procurement, implementation, transition, and post-implementation review.
Translate site need clear project charters, scopes, design briefs, delivery strategies, milestones, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.
Integrate workplace functionality, accessibility, safety, technology enablement, maintainability, and user experience into program requirements.
Coordinate with Engineering, EHS, Security, IT, Finance, Procurement, HR, site leadership, and business stakeholders to deliver cross-functional transformation outcomes.
Employee Experience & Workplace Programs
Use employee feedback, service data, workplace observations, utilization trends, and business priorities to define high-impact workplace experience programs.
Lead programs covering employee amenities, wellbeing, inclusive workplace improvements, collaboration spaces, canteen and welfare facilities, mobility, and workplace services.
Create change management, communication, engagement, and adoption plans for major workplace changes.
Establish experience measures and service outcomes, including satisfaction, adoption, accessibility, response quality, and sustained usage.
Portfolio Management, Capital Planning & Business Cases
Own the workplace program portfolio, including intake, prioritization, sequencing, dependency management, resource planning, and portfolio-level risk management.
Develop robust business cases with problem statements, options analysis, cost estimates, benefits, risks, implementation approaches, and financial justification.
Prepare and maintain annual and multi-year capital and operating plans, funding requests, forecasts, cash-flow profiles, and commitment tracking.
Monitor portfolio health across scope, budget, schedule, quality, risk, benefits, and stakeholder readiness, escalating decisions and corrective actions promptly.
Maintain executive dashboards and portfolio reviews that clearly communicate status, financial position, key decisions, risks, and realized value.
Program Execution & Benefits Realization
Establish integrated program plans, governance forums, decision rights, workstreams, stage gates, controls, and reporting standards.
Drive delivery against approved scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, and operational continuity requirements.
Define program benefits, baselines, targets, owners, measurement methods, and realization timing before implementation approval.
Conduct readiness reviews, commissioning and handover governance, lessons learned, and post-implementation benefit reviews.
Intervene when delivery deviates from plan and lead recovery actions, scope decisions, risk mitigation, and stakeholder alignment.
Sustainability & Workplace Innovation
Embed sustainability objectives into workplace programs, including energy and water efficiency, waste reduction, responsible materials, circularity, and lifecycle value.
Develop and deliver sustainability initiatives with defined baselines, targets, implementation plans, measurement methods, and verified outcomes.
Evaluate workplace technologies and innovative service models through structured pilots, value assessment, scalability reviews, and deployment plans.
Partner with EHS, Engineering, Procurement, Finance, and service providers to support site and corporate sustainability commitments.
Financial Management & Executive Reporting
Own program-level budget planning, cost control, forecasting, variance analysis, funding utilization, and financial reporting.
Validate commercial assumptions, estimates, proposals, change requests, and total-cost-of-ownership implications with Finance and Procurement.
Prepare concise executive updates, investment papers, steering committee materials, decision briefs, and escalation reports.
Ensure decisions, approvals, financial commitments, changes, risks, and benefits are documented and traceable.
Strategic Governance, Risk & Assurance
Apply fit-for-purpose program governance and assurance controls proportionate to program scale, complexity, and risk.
Identify and manage strategic delivery risks, including funding, schedule, operational disruption, stakeholder adoption, safety, compliance, vendor capacity, and benefit leakage.
Ensure programs incorporate applicable legal, EHS, security, accessibility, business continuity, and corporate requirements in partnership with the accountable subject-matter owners.
Use audits, reviews, benchmarks, service data, and lessons learned to strengthen delivery standards and portfolio performance.
CREW Strategic Leadership & Program Delivery
CREW owns strategy, program sponsorship, portfolio prioritization, business cases, funding governance, stakeholder alignment, design intent, delivery assurance, executive reporting, and benefits realization.
IFM partners and other appointed service providers own contracted operational execution, including routine operations, preventive and corrective maintenance, manpower deployment, work-order management, inspections, service-level delivery, and operational records.
The Program Manager defines outcomes and governance, assures delivery, resolves cross-functional barriers, and holds providers accountable without replacing the service provider’s site operational management responsibilities.
Escalate material service-provider performance gaps through contractual governance and require documented recovery plans, owners, milestones, and closure evidence.
Stakeholder, Vendor & Change Leadership
Build senior stakeholder alignment across site leadership and corporate functions, and facilitate timely decisions on priorities, funding, scope, and risk.
Develop scopes of work and evaluation criteria for consultants, contractors, and program partners in collaboration with Procurement and technical stakeholders.
Govern vendor performance against deliverables, milestones, quality, commercial terms, and expected outcomes.
Lead structured communications and change adoption to minimize disruption and embed new workplace solutions.
Success Measures
Approved multi-year roadmap and funded portfolio aligned with business priorities.
Programs delivered within approved scope, budget, schedule, quality, safety, and continuity requirements.
Measurable benefits realized in employee experience, workplace functionality, sustainability, risk reduction, and lifecycle value.
Accurate executive reporting, timely decision-making, and transparent portfolio governance.
Clear accountability between program leadership and IFM operational delivery, with sustained closure of performance gaps.

Qualification

REQUIRED:

Bachelor's degree in Facilities Management, Engineering, Project Management, Real Estate, Business, or related discipline.
Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in program management, workplace transformation, facilities modernization, capital projects, or corporate real estate.
Proven experience delivering complex cross-functional programs, covering scope, schedule, budget, risk, governance, and measurable benefits.
Experience developing business cases, capital proposals, portfolio roadmaps, financial forecasts, and executive-level reporting.
Practical experience governing consultants, contractors, and IFM service providers in a client-side environment.
Strong commercial judgment, analytical capability, stakeholder management/influence, executive communication, and decision facilitation skills.

Prefered

Manufacturing or large-site environment experience.
Working knowledge of project and program management methodologies.
PMP, PRINCE2, PgMP, or equivalent certification.
Knowledge of sustainability principles, lifecycle costing, change management, and workplace experience measurement.
Strategic, outcomes-focused, and able to take ownership from concept through benefits realization.
Ability to translate ambiguous requirements into structured programs and executable plans.
Comfortable working across senior leadership, technical teams, employees, vendors, and service providers.
Data-driven, commercially aware, collaborative, accountable, and customer-focused.

Additional Information

Sandisk thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. We are committed to an inclusive environment where every individual can thrive through a sense of belonging, respect and contribution.

Sandisk is committed to offering opportunities to applicants with disabilities and ensuring all candidates can successfully navigate our careers website and our hiring process. Please contact us at jobs.accommodations@sandisk.com to advise us of your accommodation request. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Project Manager (Client Delivery)

Location:
London, hybrid (Must have right to work in the UK)

About ThreatSpike

ThreatSpike is the AI-Managed IT Department. We deliver fully managed IT and complete security as one platform, one team, one fixed price, replacing the legacy MSP model entirely. Every business we work with gets world-class IT from day one, gets measurably better every week, and never has to manage a vendor relationship again.

We are the first company to operate as both the technology vendor and the service provider simultaneously. Agentic AI runs through every layer of how we operate, and our forward-deployed engineers execute against a structured roadmap in our customers’ environments every day. Today, ThreatSpike protects more than 400 customers across 90 countries, and following our Series A we are growing fast.

The Role

As a Project Manager at ThreatSpike, you will deliver small to medium-sized customer projects on time and to a high standard. You will be placed across multiple accounts, usually reporting into an Engagement Manager, and you will be the day-to-day delivery voice for the customer.

You will work within our PMO function, balancing several engagements at once while keeping plans, risks and communications tight. For smaller new customers, you may also be put forward to lead onboarding, becoming the first main representative of the ThreatSpike Delivery team and setting the tone for the relationship.

What you’ll be doing

Delivering small to medium-sized projects on established customer accounts, from kick-off through to handover into continuous operations, on time and to quality
Working alongside an Engagement Manager, taking ownership of project plans, delivery milestones and day-to-day customer communication
Balancing multiple engagements at once as part of the PMO function, prioritising effectively as demands shift
Identifying, logging and reporting risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies (RAID) and escalating them early, with clear options, for steering
Producing clear, accurate status reporting for customers and internal stakeholders
Selecting and applying the right delivery approach for each project, whether waterfall, Agile/Scrum or a hybrid
Coordinating across ThreatSpike’s internal teams (engineering, security operations, service delivery, product) so the customer gets a seamless experience and our forward-deployed engineers are set up to succeed
Building strong, trusted relationships with customers and colleagues alike
Where appropriate, leading the onboarding of small to medium-sized new customers as the first main ThreatSpike Delivery representative
Following and helping to improve ThreatSpike’s delivery playbook, tooling and governance, and feeding back what you learn on live projects

About You: experience and skills

Essential:

Around 3–5 years’ project management experience in IT environments, with a track record of delivering technical projects to time and quality
A background in AI, infrastructure or cybersecurity delivery
Working knowledge of project management frameworks, including waterfall and Scrum/Agile, and the judgement to choose the right one for the project
Experience running several projects or workstreams at the same time without letting quality or communication slip
Confidence in RAID management and in reporting risks and issues clearly to steering groups
Enough technical understanding to engage with engineers, understand dependencies and spot when something doesn’t add up
Excellent written and verbal communication, tailored to the audience

Nice to have:

Experience in managed services, enterprise SaaS or cybersecurity delivery
Experience leading or supporting customer onboarding
A recognised project management qualification (for example PRINCE2, PMP, APM or Scrum/Agile certification)
Experience working with customers across multiple time zones

About You: education and personal attributes

Degree educated with a 2:1 or higher; no specific subject is required
An excellent team player and collaborator who builds trust quickly with colleagues across engineering, security and service delivery
Skilled at forming relationships between customers and colleagues, and comfortable being the first face of ThreatSpike Delivery to a new customer
Organised and self-directed, able to take an ambiguous goal, structure it into a plan and drive it to completion
Comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where priorities shift and the playbook is still being written

What you get

Direct exposure to a range of customer accounts and project types across AI, infrastructure and cybersecurity
The chance to work closely with Engagement Managers and the wider Delivery team in a fast-scaling, category-defining business
Early opportunities to lead customer onboarding and build your own customer relationships
Hybrid working from our London, Mayfair office, with travel to customer sites across the UK as projects require (many are in London, but not all)

jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager - CyberSec
jobs.description:
Senior Project Manager / Technical Program Manager

We're looking for a seasoned Senior Project Manager/Technical Program Manager
to own the coordination and delivery of complex, cross-functional software initiatives. This role sits at the intersection of Agile delivery management and operational execution. You'll be equally comfortable running a sprint retro and troubleshooting a live demo in front of senior executives.

The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, brings structure to fast-moving technical teams, and is fluent in using AI tools to scale their own effectiveness.

Key Responsibilities
Cross-functional delivery coordination

Serve as the central point of coordination across software development, product management, and operations teams, ensuring deliverables are scoped, tracked, and landed on schedule.

End-to-end SW program ownership

Manage delivery of technical initiatives spanning infrastructure builds, automated test tooling, telemetry/debug systems, and large-scale data pipelines, often supporting hardware/device validation and bring-up processes.

Quality and readiness gatekeeping

Act as a checkpoint between engineering completion and downstream production or factory release, ensuring software meets validation and calibration standards before sign-off.

Operational management

Take hands-on ownership of operational functions such as tech support workflows, community/user engagement programs, and device or fleet management, not just software timelines, but the people and processes that support them.

Data pipeline alignment

Coordinate closely between teams generating data and teams consuming it (e.g., research or product teams), ensuring outputs match evolving downstream requirements, including transitions between different data sourcing methodologies.

Executive-facing demo management

Plan, script, and run live product demos for senior leadership and executive audiences, including real-time troubleshooting and contingency management to ensure flawless execution under pressure.

AI-native reporting and tracking

Build or leverage AI-powered agents and dashboards to automatically track deliverables, flag risks, and generate stakeholder-ready status reports, reducing manual reporting overhead and improving visibility.

Stakeholder communication

Translate technical progress and blockers into clear, concise updates for both engineering leadership and non-technical executive stakeholders.

Process innovation

In situations with no existing playbook, prototype new workflows and approaches, then codify learnings into standard operating procedures (SOPs) that scale across the broader team or organization.

Team leadership

Manage and mentor a small team or group of coordinators/contributors supporting operational functions, fostering an AI-forward, efficiency-driven culture.

Requirements

8+ years of experience in technical program/project management, ideally within software engineering or hardware/software integration environments
Strong working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies, with proven experience running sprint ceremonies, backlog grooming, and iterative delivery cycles
Demonstrated experience coordinating multiple engineering teams simultaneously, with strong prioritization and risk management skills
Comfort operating in high-visibility, high-pressure settings (executive demos, live troubleshooting)
Familiarity with AI/automation tools for reporting, tracking, or workflow optimization
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to flex between technical and executive audiences

Preferred Qualifications

PMP, PMI-ACP, SAFe, or equivalent certification
Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science or IT or Business Admin
Experience with hardware/software co-development environments (e.g., device calibration, chip bring-up, factory validation)
Prior experience building or managing AI-powered internal tools or dashboards
Life sciences domain experience preferred
Cybersecurity, Endpoint and M365, Cloud and Network, IT Service Management, ITIL Process and Training experience preferred

Benefits

Why QualityAI?

jobs.description:
Argyll Scott is hiring a Transition Technical Project Manager to join our technology consulting division in Singapore.
We are building our consulting team and are looking for a Transition Technical Project Manager to join us as a consultant, deployed on client missions. Your first mission is already secured: a Japanese global medical technology and optics group, moving its core infrastructure services into a managed service model across Asia Pacific.
You will own the implementation and transition of three foundational towers, Workplace and Collaboration, Identity and Access Management, and Cloud and Compute, working with the client's technology leadership, the incumbent teams and the incoming managed service provider through to steady state.
What you will do on the first mission
- Own the integrated transition plan across the three towers, suppliers, incumbent teams and client stakeholders.
- Lead mobilisation, knowledge transfer, tooling readiness, shadow and reverse shadow, go live, hypercare and operational acceptance.
- Run schedules, resources, dependencies, RAID, milestones and readiness gates.
- Coordinate ServiceNow readiness: workflows, resolver groups, service catalogue, CMDB interfaces and reporting.
- Drive SIAM and ITSM integration across incident, problem, change, request, major incident and knowledge.
- Set clear RACI and handoffs between the managed service provider, Service Desk, SIAM and client teams.
- Lead hypercare into steady state, tracking SLAs, KPIs and transition defects through to closure.
What we are looking for
- A strong technical delivery background, with hands on leadership of at least one large outsourcing transition into managed services.
- Experience across more than one of Workplace and M365, Intune, Identity and Access Management, and Cloud and Compute.
- Working knowledge of ServiceNow, ITSM and SIAM operating models.
- Confidence to challenge suppliers constructively and drive technical dependencies to closure.
- Disciplined governance and clear communication with senior stakeholders.
- Transition experience on the service provider side is welcome.
Why join Argyll Scott Consulting
- A permanent home with Argyll Scott, and a career of missions rather than a single contract.
- Ground floor of a growing consulting division, with real ownership and visibility.
- A first mission already secured with a respected global group, on a high visibility programme.
- Competitive package and long term development.

Introduction

Are looking for an exciting opportunity to make an impact and advance your career?

Join us and be part of a revolutionary team shaping the future!

THE POSITION

The State of Connecticut , Department of Mental Health and Addiction Services (DMHAS) is now hiring for a Business Integrity and Operational Efficiency Program Manager (State Program Manager) to join their team! This position will be accountable for data-driven fiscal oversight, business process redesign, internal controls, operational productivity, and expenditure management in high-cost nonclinical departments.

HIGHLIGHTS

FACILITY: Connecticut Valley Hospital (CVH)
UNIT: CVH Administration
LOCATION: 1000 Silver Street, Middletown, CT
SCHEDULE: Full-Time, 40 Hours per Week, First Shift, Monday through Friday, 8:00am - 4:30pm
POSITION NUMBER: 155618

What We Can Offer You

Visit our new State Employee Benefits Overview page!
Professional growth and development opportunities
A healthy work/life balance to all employees

DISCOVER THE OPPORTUNITY TO

Strengthen fiscal accountability, operational efficiency, and business integrity across CVH's high-cost nonclinical departments, particularly Food Services, Plant Facilities, and Warehouse Operations;
Provide hospital-wide leadership in data-driven financial oversight, business process redesign, internal controls, and compliance monitoring; and
Work collaboratively with the COO, Finance, and departmental managers to identify inefficiencies, implement sustainable process improvements, and establish standardized accountability measures.

About Us

DMHAS is a health care agency whose mission is to promote the overall health and wellness of persons with behavioral health needs through an integrated network of holistic, comprehensive, effective, and efficient services and supports that foster dignity, respect, and self-sufficiency in those we serve.

CVH opened in 1868 as the State’s public hospital for the treatment of persons with mental illness. Today, CVH is the largest of DMHAS facilities, and includes 17 inpatient units over two campuses (Middletown and Hartford). The hospital includes both a general psychiatry and addiction services units. CVH provides comprehensive inpatient and outpatient psychiatric care and substance abuse treatment, including treatment for pregnant women and persons with dual diagnoses. Specialty areas include geriatric and special services, an integrated network of comprehensive mental health services for older adults and young adult services. The facility also runs the Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI) program which addresses the needs of TBI survivors, including reintegration into community living, independent living skills development, vocational and educational training, psychiatric, cognitive and neurological assessment and treatment, speech and physical rehabilitation as well as individual and family counseling.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Data - Lead

About Us

Open Secret is a fast-growing, innovation-driven food & beverage brand making snacks for new India. We are on a mission to transform the way India snacks by creating a range of “unjunked” food options that are delicious, healthier, and guilt-free. We blend food science, great taste, and transparency to create better-for-you products families love.
Our Founder and CEO, Ahana Gautam, is a graduate from IIT Bombay and Harvard Business School, and has a strong FMCG background – Procter & Gamble and General Mills.
We are backed by a stellar group of investors—including Matrix, Sixth Sense, Ananta Capital, Vijay Shekhar Sharma, and other prominent leaders.
Join us in the Unjunked Revolution.
Location:
Mumbai (in office)
Experience Level:
4 – 7 years
Role Overview

We are looking for a Data Analyst Manager to build and lead our analytics function. This role goes beyond reporting. It is about creating a single source of truth across channels, turning data into decisions for Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain and Finance, and using AI to automate everyday work and unlock new ways of running the business. You will build the team and capability that scale with a high-growth consumer brand.

Key Responsibilities

Data Foundation:

a. Bring together sales, inventory, marketing, finance and operations data into one reliable view.
b. Pull in data from quick commerce platforms, marketplaces, modern trade, general trade and the D2C website.
c. Define common KPIs and metrics so that every team works off the same numbers.
d. Put checks in place so that data is accurate before it reaches dashboards and reports.

Business Insights & Decision Support:

a. Partner with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance and Leadership to turn business questions into clear analyses.
b. Track channel performance, SKU velocity, availability, pricing, promotions and trade spend effectiveness.
c. Understand customer behaviour: repeat purchase, retention, order value and channel-level profitability.
d. Support marketing teams with ROI and campaign performance analysis.
e. Support planning with demand, sell-through and inventory insights.

AI Workflows & Use Case Building:

a. Identify where AI can create the most value across functions (sales, marketing, supply chain, finance, customer experience) and prioritise use cases by impact and ease of execution.
b. Build AI-enabled workflows that automate repetitive work, such as report generation, channel reconciliations, deduction checks and alerts for unusual numbers.
c. Create simple AI tools for business teams, such as asking questions of company data in plain language and getting automated summaries.
d. Take use cases from idea to working prototype to everyday use, with clear owners and success measures.
e. Evaluate AI tools and vendors with attention to cost, accuracy and data security.
f. Train teams to use AI well and set clear guidelines for responsible use of company data.

Dashboards & Reporting:

a. Own leadership dashboards and regular management reports on revenue, margins, growth and channel health.
b. Replace manual spreadsheets with automated reporting.
c. Choose and set up the right tools for the stage of the business.

Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management:

a. Lead, mentor and develop a team of analysts.
b. Prioritise the analytics and AI roadmap based on business impact, and set clear delivery standards.
c. Build a culture of data-driven decision-making across the organisation.
d. Present insights and recommendations to the leadership team in a clear, concise manner.

Governance & Process Building:

a. Set up data access, documentation and quality standards, including guidelines for AI use.
b. Design simple processes for data requests, report ownership and refresh cycles.
c. Build processes that scale with growth and reduce reliance on manual work.

Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Statistics, Economics, Commerce or a related field. MBA is a plus.
4–7 years of experience in business or data analytics, with at least 1–2 years managing or mentoring analysts.
Experience in FMCG / D2C / E-commerce / Quick Commerce / Consumer Tech will be a strong advantage.
Strong command of Excel / Google Sheets and SQL. Comfort with at least one dashboarding tool (Power BI, Tableau, Looker or similar).
Hands-on experience using AI tools and automation to solve real business problems. Prior experience building AI-enabled workflows is a strong plus.
Strong understanding of consumer business metrics such as repeat rate, order value, margins and promotion impact.
Exposure to quick commerce and marketplace data (Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, Amazon, Flipkart) is a plus.
Structured, hypothesis-driven problem solving with strong communication and stakeholder influencing skills.
i. A builder mindset: comfortable going from idea to working prototype quickly and measuring real business impact.
j. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial startup environment.

What’s in It for You?

Chance to build the analytics function and AI capability from scratch, working closely with top leadership
Freedom to pick AI use cases, build them and see them used across the company
Exposure across Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance and Strategy
Direct mentorship from founders and senior leaders
Accelerated growth opportunities in a growing F&B startup

About Sibylline

Sibylline is the world's largest private intelligence firm, helping organisations manage risk, spot opportunity, and build resilience in an increasingly volatile world.

We're looking for people who are ambitious, discreet, and sharp, with strong integrity and a genuine curiosity about the world. If you're comfortable with uncertainty, energised by complex problems, and passionate about global affairs, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Description

Position Summary

We are looking for a highly motivated and analytical Threat Intelligence Analyst to support a client's global security and risk management functions. Embedded within the client environment, you will identify, investigate, assess, and communicate threats and emerging risks impacting personnel, operations, assets, facilities, and brand reputation.

As the Threat Intelligence Analyst, you will work closely with stakeholders across corporate security, physical security, investigations, and business operations teams to deliver timely intelligence products, investigative findings, and operational support.

Working hours and arrangement:
this is a fully remote role in Australia, requiring to work Monday to Friday, 8 am - 5 pm AEDT, with some weekend work on a rotational basis.

Essential Functions / Responsibilities

Monitor, collect, and analyse information from a variety of sources to identify threats, risks, and emerging trends impacting personnel, operations, assets, facilities, and brand reputation.
Conduct online investigations and assess threat actors, online communities, suspicious activity, and emerging risks relevant to corporate and physical security operations.
Produce timely intelligence products, investigative reports, alerts, and briefings to support decision-making and risk mitigation efforts.
Leverage OSINT methodologies, social media analysis, public records research, and commercial intelligence platforms to support intelligence collection and investigative activities.
Develop investigative leads, conduct due diligence and attribution research, and synthesise findings from disparate information sources into actionable intelligence.
Triage and respond to requests for intelligence and investigative support, delivering timely and relevant insights to stakeholders.
Support critical incident response efforts through rapid research, analysis, and dissemination of relevant information.
Maintain intelligence records, analytical databases, and case management systems to support ongoing operations.
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to enhance threat identification, risk mitigation, and security outcomes.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Experience supporting security, intelligence, investigations, trust and safety, or risk management programs within technology companies, government agencies, or private-sector intelligence organisations.
Strong understanding of threat intelligence, investigative methodologies, threat actor research, and intelligence collection and analysis practices.
Strong proficiency in OSINT collection, social media analysis, public records research, and online investigative techniques.
Experience utilising commercial investigative and intelligence platforms such as LexisNexis, Dataminr, Flashpoint, or similar technologies.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to identify patterns, assess risk, and produce actionable intelligence from complex information.
Ability to communicate findings clearly and effectively through written products, briefings, and stakeholder engagement.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment while handling sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
Experience utilizing AI and emerging technologies to enhance research, information analysis, investigative workflows, and operational efficiency.
Commitment to objectivity, professional ethics, analytical rigor, and continuous learning.
Ability to transform complex information into actionable intelligence that enables decision-makers to mitigate risk, enhance security operations, and support informed security and business decisions.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or higher in Security Studies, International Relations, Criminal Justice, Political Science, Intelligence Studies, Business Management, Journalism, or a related discipline; or equivalent professional experience.
3+ years of professional experience in threat intelligence, intelligence analysis, investigations, OSINT, corporate security, trust and safety, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience conducting investigative research, intelligence collection, and threat analysis.
Experience researching threat actors, online communities, or emerging security threats.
Proven ability to produce high-quality analytical reports and intelligence products.

Additional Information

Interview Process

Initial call with our Talent Acquisition team member
Timed written assessment (arranged at a time that suits you) to test writing and analytical capability
Verbal Briefing during panel interview with team members and hiring managers at Sibylline
Meet and Greet with the client

Research indicates that certain groups are less likely to apply for a position unless they meet every single requirement. If you feel you meet some of the requirements and can offer a unique perspective to this role, we strongly encourage you to apply—you might be the perfect fit we're looking for!

Sibylline is committed to the recruitment and selection of candidates without regard for sexual orientation, gender, ethnicity, age, political beliefs, culture, and lifestyle. We are committed to fostering a business culture that reflects these values and promotes equal opportunity.

jobs.description:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Hamburger Teams Data Intelligence suchen wir ab 01.02.2027 einen (Senior) Data Analyst (m/w/d).

Deine Aufgaben bei uns:

Deine Mission ist es, deine Kollegen mittels aus Daten gewonnener Erkenntnisse zu besseren Entscheidungen im Tagesgeschäft zu befähigen.
Dazu analysierst, modellierst und visualisierst du vor allem Daten entlang der Wertschöpfungskette(n) moderner Buchverlage (bspw. Verkäufe, Lagerbestände, Marketing-KPI), sowie Markt- und Zielgruppen - Daten aus externen Quellen (bspw. MediaControl, Amazon API, Rezensionen & Consumer-Sentiment).
Die gewonnenen Insights vermittelst du auch an nicht-technische Mitarbeiter prägnant und nachvollziehbar.
Wiederkehrende Analyse- und Reporting-Prozesse automatisierst du ganz selbstverständlich und hilfst dabei, unsere Self-Service BI Landschaft zu modernisieren und zu erweitern.
Du vernetzt dich mit deinen Kollegen in unseren Verlagen, erhebst Anforderungen und tauscht dich regelmäßig zu deren Herausforderungen aus. Daraus leitest du gemeinsam mit deiner Führungskraft sinnvolle Analyse-Blickwinkel ab.
Als Teil des zentralen Data Intelligence - Teams der Holtzbrinck Buchverlage stehst du im engen Austausch mit unseren Data Engineers & Entwicklern. Dein Input trägt maßgeblich zur Modernisierung unserer DWH - Umgebung bei.

Das bringst du mit:

Du hast ein Studium im Bereich der Informatik, Natur-, Sozial- oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften mit empirischem Schwerpunkt erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
Du kannst auf mindestens 3 Jahre praktischer Erfahrung in einer Data Analytics oder Data Science Funktion zurückblicken. Analyse-Erfahrung im Medienumfeld (Bücher, News, Musik, Film, Gaming etc.) ist ein großes Plus.
Standards und Paradigmen der wissenschaftlichen Arbeit sind dir vertraut; du kennst das Einmaleins der Statistik wie deine Westentasche und kannst Laien in einem Satz erklären, was der Unterschied zwischen Mittelwert und Median ist.
Du beherrschst SQL, sowie R und/oder Python und visualisierst Daten in einer BI Suite, bspw. Tableau, Power BI oder Looker.
Du denkst nicht nur analytisch und bist von Natur aus neugierig, sondern schaffst es auch mit deiner Kommunikationsstärke, dein Umfeld für die Welt der Daten zu begeistern. Dabei reflektierst Du zu jeder Zeit das Spannungsfeld zwischen Kreativität, Business & Technologie.
Bücher sind deine Leidenschaft und du hast ein ausgeprägtes Interesse am Verlagswesen, Literatur und (Pop-)Kultur. Du erkennst die Chancen, die für die Buchbranche in Digitalisierung, Daten und KI liegen.
Du kommunizierst souverän auf Deutsch (C1-Niveau) und bewegst dich auch im englischen Fachvokabular absolut sicher.

Was wir dir bieten:

Modernes Arbeiten:
Ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und moderner technischer Ausstattung.

Kultur:
Die kreative, inspirierende Atmosphäre von fünf Buchverlagen, kombiniert mit der Professionalität und Sicherheit einer Holdingstruktur.

Entwicklung:
Viel Raum für persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung in einem spannenden Transformationsumfeld.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen inklusive Gehaltsvorstellung und möglichem Eintrittstermin.
