About The Role

As a SOC Cyber Security Analyst at Hyland, you will investigate and respond to security incidents escalated from the associate level, with a strong focus on cloud incident response and threat detection across AWS and Azure. You will perform in-depth analysis, contain threats using established playbooks, escalate complex cases to the senior level, and help improve detections and automation — while supporting and guiding associate level analysts in a collaborative and innovative security organization.

This role is a great fit for a hands-on analyst with a solid investigative mindset who is ready to grow toward senior incident response and threat hunting.

Technology Tools

SIEM & XDR: Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, EDR/XDR platforms
Cloud Security: AWS CloudTrail, AWS GuardDuty, AWS Security Hub, Microsoft Defender for Cloud
Identity & Access: Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Azure Activity/Sign-in/Audit Logs
Automation & Scripting: Python, PowerShell, SOAR platforms
Threat Intelligence: MITRE ATT&CK framework, Threat Intelligence platforms (TIPs)

Your Role Responsibilities – Here's What You'll Do

Triage, investigate, and respond to security incidents escalated from the associate level, performing root cause analysis and containment across cloud (AWS, Azure), on-premises, and hybrid environments
Investigate cloud security events — including suspicious IAM and Entra ID activity, compromised credentials, anomalous API activity, and malicious OAuth app consent — using CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Azure Activity/Sign-in/Audit logs, Defender, and Sentinel
Execute and refine incident response playbooks, escalating complex or high-severity incidents to the senior level with clear evidence and timelines
Tune detection rules and use cases (KQL, SPL) to reduce false positives, improve alert quality, and recommend new detections
Leverage Python, PowerShell, and SOAR playbooks to automate repetitive investigation and response tasks, applying AI-assisted triage where available
Mentor and support associate level analysts through knowledge sharing, case reviews, and on-the-job coaching, while actively contributing to post-incident reviews and security documentation

Role Essentials – What You'll Need

Bachelor's degree in Cyber Security, IT, Computer Science, or equivalent experience
4+ years in SOC, Incident Response, Threat Detection, or Security Operations — including at least 1–2 years of hands-on experience investigating cloud security incidents
Proven experience investigating incidents in AWS and Azure/Microsoft Entra ID using CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Azure Activity/Sign-in/Audit logs, Defender, and Sentinel
Hands-on proficiency with SIEM, EDR/XDR, and threat intelligence tools across Windows and Linux/Unix environments
Strong analytical and investigative mindset with the ability to run investigations independently, document findings clearly, and escalate when appropriate

What We'd Like to See – Preferred Skills

Experience with detection tuning and MITRE ATT&CK mapping, including the Cloud matrix
Exposure to threat hunting and digital forensics across memory, disk, and cloud environments
Scripting and automation skills using Python, PowerShell, or APIs, with SOAR playbook experience
Familiarity with AI-assisted SOC operations, Agentic AI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Relevant certifications such as Microsoft SC-200, AZ-500, AWS Security Specialty, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, or CompTIA Security+/CySA+

This intermediate role works closely with IT Infrastructure, application owners, vendors, and business teams to maintain practical security controls while supporting reliable day-to-day operations.

Responsibilities:

Security Operations & Incident Response

• Monitor security alerts, logs, dashboards, and system notifications; investigate suspicious activity and escalate confirmed or high-risk events in accordance with established procedures.
• Participate in the containment, investigation, recovery, and documentation of security incidents, including phishing, malware, account compromise, unauthorized access, and data exposure concerns.

• Manage and maintain centralized syslog collection from firewalls, switches, wireless controllers, servers, VPNs, and other infrastructure; ensure log sources are onboarded, time-synchronized, retained according to policy, and reviewed for security events, anomalies, and audit purposes.
• Assist with security monitoring improvements, alert tuning, operational runbooks, and repeatable response procedures.
Identity, Access & Microsoft 365 Security

• Administer and review security controls across Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Intune, and Microsoft Defender.
• Support identity and access controls, including multifactor authentication, Conditional Access, role-based access, privileged access, guest/external access, and account lifecycle reviews.
• Perform periodic access reviews and work with system owners to remove unnecessary, inactive, excessive, or conflicting permissions.
• Investigate authentication, mailbox, collaboration, and account-related security events and recommend corrective actions.
Endpoint, Cloud & Infrastructure Security

• Support endpoint protection, device compliance, secure configuration, encryption, patching, application control, and vulnerability remediation for Windows devices and servers.
• Assist with firewall, VPN, network, wireless, cloud, server, and backup security reviews in collaboration with infrastructure specialists.
• Review security posture and configuration findings for Azure, AWS, SaaS platforms, and other hosted systems used by the organization.
• Validate remediation activities and document accepted risks, exceptions, compensating controls, and outstanding actions.
Vulnerability & Risk Management

• Coordinate vulnerability scanning, triage findings, prioritize remediation based on severity and business impact, and track issues through closure.
• Assist with secure configuration baselines, patch compliance reporting, risk assessments, third-party security reviews, and audit evidence collection.
• Monitor relevant threat and vulnerability information and translate it into practical actions for GuestTek systems and tools.
• Support periodic testing of backups, recovery procedures, security controls, and response readiness.
Business Systems, SaaS & Vendor Security

• Partner with application owners to assess the security of business systems, integrations, service accounts, APIs, and administrative access.
• Participate in security reviews for new tools, major changes, vendor access, data integrations, and technology implementations before production use.
• Coordinate remediation activities with vendors and internal owners, ensuring security requirements, responsibilities, and evidence are documented.
• Maintain an inventory of security-relevant systems, owners, administrative accounts, integrations, and key controls.
Governance, Awareness & Documentation

• Create and maintain security procedures, standards, knowledge articles, asset records, diagrams, risk records, and control documentation.
• Support policy compliance, internal reviews, customer or audit requests, and security awareness initiatives.
• Support ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 1, and SOC 2 audit and assurance activities by coordinating evidence collection, maintaining control documentation, responding to auditor requests, tracking findings, and working with control owners to complete remediation actions.
• Provide practical guidance to employees and technical teams on secure use of systems, phishing prevention, password and access practices, and incident reporting.
• Contribute to change management, service management, problem management, and continuous improvement activities.
QUALIFICATIONS

Required

jobs.title: AVP/VP, Data Analyst, Operational Risk Management
jobs.description:
GIC is one of the world's largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 locations around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world's industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we Work at the Point of Impact for Singapore's financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide.

Risk & Performance Management Department

In Risk & Performance Management Department (RPMD), we work collaboratively across teams to identify and address potential blind spots, ensuring that all relevant risks are considered and duly addressed.

Operational Risk Management

The Operational Risk Management (ORM) team is responsible for driving and managing the corporate operational risk management programme within GIC. Operational risk tools and analytics are developed to better inform management about the operational risk landscape. We are looking for a dynamic and self-motivated individual to join the team as an Assistant Vice President/ Vice President, focusing on data analytics to strengthen risk and control oversight.

What impact can you make in this role?

You will be part of a team responsible for the independent assessment, measurement, monitoring and reporting of GIC's operational risk profile. You will bring a data-driven approach across the team's mandate, using analytics and AI/LLM tools to evaluate controls, support third-party and outsourcing risk assessments, generate insights, and strengthen the firm's overall risk and control environment.

What will you do as an AVP/VP in ORM?
Develop and maintain dashboards and data analytics capability to meet the team's risk analysis, monitoring and reporting needs
Analyse and interpret large data sets to identify risks, control gaps, trends and thematic issues, and translate findings into actionable recommendations
Apply data analytics to enhance control assurance and testing (e.g. automating test procedures, running full-population testing on raw transactional data in place of sampling, and identifying control exceptions and anomalies)
Support third-party and outsourcing due diligence and risk assessments with data-driven analysis (e.g. vendor risk data, concentration analysis, and identification of emerging risks)
Leverage AI/LLM tools to augment risk and control workflows (e.g. reviewing documentation, extracting and summarising key information from contracts and reports, comparing responses against policy requirements to flag gaps, and generating first-cut insights for reviewer refinement)
Track, collate and report key risk indicators (KRIs) and key performance indicators (KPIs) across the team's remit, and analyse trends to flag emerging risks and control weaknesses
Monitor and report risk and control outcomes to senior management and GIC's risk governance committees
Contribute to the design and continuous improvement of methodologies, frameworks and supporting tools, including embedding AI/analytics into assessment workflows
Work with risk managers and business stakeholders to embed a rigorous, data-driven approach across the team's activities

What qualifications or skills should you possess in this role?

Must-haves: At least 5 (AVP) and 7 (VP) years' experience in data analytics, business intelligence or a related field
Strong / advanced proficiency in data mining, analysis and visualisation tools (e.g. Databricks, Tableau), and programming languages such as Python and SQL
Practical experience applying AI/LLM tools to analytics or risk work (e.g. document review, summarisation, gap analysis, and workflow automation)

Good to have: Experience in control assurance, control testing, or a related assurance discipline, including familiarity with control frameworks and testing methodologies
Experience in third-party risk management, vendor due diligence or outsourcing risk, including familiarity with due diligence methodologies and risk assessment frameworks
Broader domain knowledge in operational risk, audit or a related risk and controls field

Attributes: Intellectually curious, with a passion for using data and AI to connect the dots and generate insights that translate into value for stakeholders
Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to synthesise diverse information into clear conclusions
Adept at presenting findings in strong, digestible visuals
Forward-thinking and keen to stay current with developments in the risk, analytics and AI space
Excellent interpersonal, communication and presentation skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally across business areas and seniority levels
Strong organisational and project management skills

Work at the Point of Impact

We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.

Flexibility at GIC

At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration, but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.

GIC is an equal opportunity employer

As an employer, we passionately believe every individual brings with them unique diversity of thought and perspectives to meaningfully enrich perspectives of GIC teams to drive competitive performance. An inclusive environment yields exceptional contribution.

jobs.title: Beleidsadviseur/project manager Strategy & International Relations (ADSB, 32-40 uur)
jobs.description:
Ben jij klaar voor een nieuwe uitdaging binnen een dynamische, internationale omgeving waar politiek, bedrijfsleven en financiële wereld elkaar ontmoeten? Atradius Dutch State Business zoekt voor het team Strategy & International Relations een analytische en verbindende beleidsadviseur/projectmanager. In deze functie combineer je inhoudelijke beleidsontwikkeling met stevig projectmanagement en werk je aan nationale en internationale vraagstukken die direct relevant zijn voor de Nederlandse exportsector.

Over Atradius Dutch State Business

Atradius DSB, onderdeel van de Atradius groep, voert de exportkredietverzekeringsfaciliteit (ekv) uit en biedt namens de Nederlandse staat verzekerings- en garantieproducten aan voor betalingsrisico’s bij zakendoen in het buitenland. Onze klanten zijn Nederlandse exporteurs van kapitaalgoederen of diensten, investeerders, aannemingsbedrijven en hun financiers. Naast traditionele export ondersteunen we ook de bredere internationalisatie van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven met onze producten.

Je werkt in het team Strategy & International Relations. Dit multidisciplinaire team stuurt het strategieproces aan op basis van nationale prioriteiten en internationale ontwikkelingen, adviseert de Nederlandse staat bij EU- en OESO-onderhandelingen en onderhoudt relaties met onder meer andere exportkredietverzekeraars en de Berner Unie (een internationaal netwerk van verzekeraars). We werken nauw samen met onze opdrachtgevers, de ministeries van Financiën en Buitenlandse Zaken, en met collega’s binnen Atradius DSB aan strategische beleidsvraagstukken.

Wat ga je doen?

In deze mediorfunctie ontwikkel en implementeer je beleid op het snijvlak van publieke belangen, internationale economische vraagstukken en de uitvoering van de ekv. Hierbij combineer je projectmanagement met een inhoudelijke bijdrage. Je stuurt het proces aan, verdiept je in de dossiers en brengt de kennis en inzichten van collega’s en betrokken partijen samen. Daarbij analyseer je belangen en ontwikkelingen, vorm je een onderbouwd oordeel en vertaal je dit samen met collega’s naar concrete beleidsvoorstellen en uitvoerbare oplossingen.

Je trekt zelfstandig beleidsprojecten van begin tot eind. Dit zijn je belangrijkste taken:

Projectmanagement: je stelt een aanpak en planning op, coördineert multidisciplinaire projectteams, bewaakt voortgang en kwaliteit, rapporteert over resultaten en zorgt voor tijdige besluitvorming en implementatie.
Nationale beleidscoördinatie: je draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van het Nederlandse beleid voor de ekv in samenwerking met de ministeries van Financiën en Buitenlandse Zaken en collega’s. Op specifieke dossiers coördineer je de afstemming en werk je beleidsvoorstellen uit, met oog voor de belangen van onder meer exporteurs en financiers. Je werkt aan beleidsontwikkeling en executie van strategische onderwerpen zoals transparantie, anti-fraude, vergroening en andere prioritaire vraagstukken binnen de ekv. Afhankelijk van de agenda pak je in overleg zelfstandig nieuwe thema’s op.
Internationale dossiers: je ondersteunt senior adviseurs bij de voorbereiding en opvolging van internationale overleggen binnen bestaande gremia zoals de EU-, OESO- en de Berne Union. Waar gepast neem je ook zelf deel aan deze overleggen. Je coördineert surveys en internationale rapportageverplichtingen. Je draagt bij aan de formulering van jaarplannen, bereidt Nederlandse standpunten en internationale overleggen voor, en coördineert hierin dossiers met collega’s en de Staat. Je volgt internationale ontwikkelingen, beoordeelt de betekenis daarvan voor de Nederlandse ekv en helpt deze te vertalen naar beleid en uitvoering. Op eigen dossiers vertegenwoordig je, in afstemming met senior collega’s en de Staat, mede de Nederlandse standpunten in internationale gremia.
Stakeholdermanagement: je brengt partijen met verschillende belangen bij elkaar, bouwt duurzame werkrelaties op en creëert draagvlak, ook wanneer je geen hiërarchische verantwoordelijkheid hebt.

Jouw Profiel

Je hebt een afgeronde hbo- of universitaire opleiding en 2-5 jaar relevante werkervaring, bijvoorbeeld in een beleidsfunctie, consultancy, financiële dienstverlening, een overheidsorganisatie of een internationale omgeving.
Beleidsmatig en projectmanagement: je combineert inhoudelijke beleidsvaardigheid met aantoonbare ervaring in het zelfstandig organiseren en leiden van projecten. Je kunt schakelen tussen analyse, afstemming, besluitvorming en implementatie.
Je bent analytisch en omgevingsbewust: je maakt je nieuwe dossiers snel eigen, overziet verschillende belangen en begrijpt hoe politieke, economische en uitvoeringsaspecten elkaar beïnvloeden.
Je bent sterk in schrijven en communiceren: je schrijft heldere en overtuigende adviezen en kunt complexe onderwerpen begrijpelijk uitleggen. Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
Verbindend en resultaatgericht: je brengt gemakkelijk verschillende partijen bij elkaar, neemt eigenaarschap en weet projecten vooruit te brengen zonder formele autoriteit. Affiniteit met publiek beleid, internationale economische vraagstukken, exportfinanciering en/of financiële dienstverlening is belangrijk; kennis van het Nederlandse publieke handelsinstrumentarium is een pré.

Wat bieden wij?

Bij Atradius kun je rekenen op een leuke en uitdagende plek om te werken: internationaal, dynamisch en informeel. We bevinden ons in een strategische transitie gericht op het stimuleren van verduurzaming van de Nederlandse export en investeringen in het buitenland. Met de Nederlandse staat als opdrachtgever werken we vaak aan projecten met een maatschappelijke invalshoek. Dit biedt een interessante mix tussen het leveren van een bedrijfseconomische en sociaal-maatschappelijke bijdrage. We vinden het belangrijk onze mensen een omgeving te bieden waarin ze persoonlijke groei kunnen realiseren. Atradius biedt aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden waaronder een marktconform salaris, 13e maand, variabele beloning, goede pensioenregeling en een hybride werkomgeving.

Gelijke kansen voor iedereen

Het succes van onze organisatie staat of valt met de kwaliteit van onze mensen en de ideeën die zij hebben. Echt verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen voor onze klanten ontstaan door een samenspel van culturen, kennis en ervaring. Daarom is diversiteit voor onze organisatie ontzettend belangrijk. Om ervoor te zorgen dat alle collega’s binnen Atradius DSB hun kwaliteiten kunnen ontplooien, stimuleren we een diverse en inclusieve cultuur waarin iedereen zich betrokken en gewaardeerd voelt. Kandidaten die bijdragen aan die diversiteit worden dan ook van harte uitgenodigd te reageren. 

Enthousiast en wil je solliciteren?

Dat kan via onderstaande button! 

Atradius is een wereldwijde aanbieder van kredietverzekeringen, borgstellingen en garanties, incassodiensten en informatiediensten, met een strategische aanwezigheid in meer dan 50 landen. De producten van Atradius beschermen bedrijven over de hele wereld tegen het risico van wanbetaling dat samenhangt met de verkoop van goederen en diensten op krediet. Atradius maakt deel uit van Grupo Catalana Occidente (GCO.MC), een van de grootste verzekeraars in Spanje en een van de grootste kredietverzekeraars ter wereld.

Meer informatie vind je op onze website: https://atradiusdutchstatebusiness.nl/ en https://group.atradius.com

jobs.description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

Job Description

The CAS Audit Project Manager is primarily responsible for completing internal audit engagement assignments with minimal supervision from audit team management. The Audit Project Manager is expected to understand risk and risk management techniques, identify and analyze business processes, key risks and critical controls, and evaluate control design adequacy; perform or supervise control testing; and document work performed in conformance with internal audit policies and procedures. This individual may also be involved in other side projects, department initiatives, and other administrative audit activities. The ideal candidate has internal audit experience in the financial services industry of areas including Consumer and Business Banking, Corporate and Commercial, and Capital Markets.

The primary focus of this role over the next 36 months includes completing annual key SOX financial statement control testing for internal audit and other audit support work specific to Banking Products. Internal audit performs SOX testing on behalf of management to ensure strong reliance by external auditors. The role may directly or indirectly lead team members.

Key accountabilities:

Performing control testing and/or supervising staff auditors performing control testing based on audit program directions. Includes using appropriate sampling and control testing techniques; identifying and assessing the relevance of possible issues; and documenting work performed to support audit scope and conclusions, to facilitate an efficient review, and to meet internal audit policies and procedures.
Drafting audit issues under the supervision of audit team management. Includes drafting potential exposures and significance, identifying appropriate root causes, and developing operationally effective and cost-effective recommendations.
Assisting audit team management in the reporting and wrap-up phases of audits. Includes assisting with drafting audit reports.
Learning from and applying coaching received.
Serving as a subject matter expert in a particular topic, helping drive strategy, and may support multiple audit engagements covering the related topics.
Handling complex tasks autonomously and being able to influence business line understanding of risk mitigation.
Performing other duties as requested by audit team management.
Assisting audit team management in planning audit engagements. Includes understanding risk and risk management techniques; identifying and analyzing business processes, key risks, and critical controls; interviewing auditees; and evaluating control design adequacy.
Providing coaching and on-the-job training for team members, as applicable, to ensure engagements are completed in conformance with internal audit policies and procedures.
Partnering with the assigned line of business, other Risk/Compliance/Audit (RCA) professionals and managers, and RCA Managers to, depending on their function, create, implement, maintain, review or oversee an effective risk management framework.
Participating in projects and/or activities ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations.
Identifying gaps and informing solutions that minimize losses resulting from inadequate internal processes, systems, or human errors.
Identifying, responding to, or escalating risks, as appropriate.

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
Typically 6+ years of applicable experience

Preferred Skills and Experience:

Advanced financial services industry knowledge relevant to Banking Products including Consumer and Business Banking (e.g., retail, business banking, mortgage, etc.), Corporate and Commercial Banking, and Capital Markets.
Relevant Capital Markets product knowledge, including derivatives, foreign exchange, fixed income, and municipal products.
Relevant knowledge of laws and regulations applicable to securities and derivatives, including Swap Dealer requirements, the Market Risk Rule, FINRA, MSRB, and the Volcker Rule.
Relevant mortgage product knowledge including knowledge of laws and regulations applicable to mortgage originations, i.e., the Real Estate Settlement Procedures Act (RESPA) and Truth in Lending Act (TILA).
Applicable professional certifications or credentials, such as CIA, CPA, CFSA (Certified Financial Services Auditor), CRCM (Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager), FINRA licenses, CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst), CIDA (Certified Investments & Derivatives Auditor), another relevant professional designation, or an advanced degree.
Relevant internal audit experience in the financial services industry in areas including SOX, regulatory compliance, and risk management.
Considerable knowledge of applicable laws, regulations, financial services, and regulatory trends that impact Banking Products.
Considerable understanding of Banking Product’s operations, products and services, systems, and associated risks and controls.
Considerable knowledge of Risk/Compliance/Audit competencies and the ability to hold others accountable on individual projects.
Advanced process facilitation, project management, and analytical skills for complex processes.
Thorough understanding of The Institute of Internal Auditors’ Global Internal Audit Standards and the common definition of internal controls.
Business acumen and credibility to help business lines proactively identify and address the evolving risk landscape and changing workforce needs.
Excellent presentation, interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.
Strong critical thinking and analytical skills.
Proven adaptability to changing priorities and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously.
Ability to successfully coordinate with multiple groups to complete projects.
Proficient computer navigation skills using a variety of software packages, including Microsoft applications.

I&O Platform Infrastructure Data Analyst

The opportunity

This is a unique role that bridges deep data analysis with practical infrastructure knowledge, enabling the firm to transform operational data from across its data center, compute, network, storage and observability platforms into actionable intelligence.

A key focus of this role is providing the analytical intelligence layer for the Hyperconverged Service Platform (HCSP) — EY's next-generation infrastructure automation platform built on Kubernetes, Temporal and Terraform. The Data Analyst will own the measurement, reporting and continuous improvement analysis of HCSP's provisioning performance, workflow reliability, SLA attainment, drift detection efficacy and operational impact across EY's global data center estate — directly enabling the platform team to measure success, identify failure patterns and demonstrate value.

Your Key Responsibilities

The I&O Platform Infrastructure Data Analyst collects, processes and analyzes operational data from across EY's infrastructure platforms — with a particular focus on HCSP platform telemetry — transforming raw data from workflow orchestration systems, provisioning engines, log aggregation platforms, ITSM tools and capacity management systems into meaningful insights and visualizations.

The role requires a strong analytical skill set combined with sufficient infrastructure and platform automation awareness to understand the context of the data being analyzed. The analyst will serve as the analytical authority for HCSP KPI reporting — tracking metrics such as provisioning SLA attainment, orchestrator failure rates, manual touchpoint reduction, rollback success rates and catalog drift elimination — and will partner with the HCSP engineering team, I&O leadership and service management to drive a data-informed culture of continuous platform improvement.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Strong experience designing and delivering data analytics solutions using Power BI, including complex DAX measures, data models and report publishing.
Proficiency querying and analyzing data from ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) including KQL query development and Kibana dashboard creation.
Experience working with large, multi-source operational datasets and transforming them into executive and operational reporting.
Ability to analyze and report on platform automation data, including:
Workflow execution metrics
OPA policy evaluation outcomes and policy compliance trends
Drift detection signals
ServiceNow order intake volumes, ticket correlation

Good understanding of data center infrastructure technologies including:
Windows Server and Linux operating system fundamentals
Virtualization platforms — Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware
Kubernetes cluster concepts — pods, namespaces, workloads and resource utilization
Network fundamentals — VLANs, DNS, IP management
Storage and compute provisioning concepts

Experience with SQL or KQL for querying structured and semi-structured data sources.
Experience integrating data from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow or equivalent) into analytical reporting.
Familiarity with APM and monitoring tooling (Dynatrace, SolarWinds, Prometheus or equivalent) as data sources.
Experience with ETL/ELT pipelines and data ingestion from multiple infrastructure and platform data sources.
Scripting capability to automate data extraction and transformation tasks:
Python (pandas, NumPy, requests)
PowerShell
Bash

Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to present HCSP performance findings and SLA trend analysis to both technical and senior business audiences.
Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks.
Ability to work effectively with global engineering and service management teams across multiple time zones.

To qualify for the role, you must have experience with

Power BI report and dashboard development — 5–7 years.
Power BI data modelling, DAX development and Power Query (M) transformations — 5–7 years.
ELK stack data analysis — Elasticsearch queries and Kibana dashboard development — 3–5 years.
SQL data analysis and querying against operational data stores — 5–7 years.
KPI definition, metric design and SLA/OLA reporting for platform or infrastructure services.
Data integration from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, Remedy or equivalent).
Working with infrastructure and platform automation monitoring data — metrics, logs, workflow events and traces.
Building capacity planning and trend analysis reports for infrastructure and automation platforms.
Kubernetes and container platform telemetry consumption and analysis.
Workflow orchestration data analysis — Temporal, Argo or equivalent execution logs and metrics.
OPA policy evaluation data analysis and compliance reporting.
Drift detection and configuration audit data analysis.
Windows Server and Linux operating system concepts — sufficient to contextualize infrastructure data.
Virtualization platform familiarity (Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware vSphere or Azure Stack HCI).
Python scripting for data extraction, transformation and automation — 3–5 years.
PowerShell scripting for Windows infrastructure data collection.
Executive reporting and stakeholder presentation delivery.
Azure Monitor, Log Analytics or equivalent cloud observability data sources (preferred).
Working with CMDB data to enrich infrastructure and platform analytics (preferred).

Ideally, you'll also have

Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) certification (desired).
Elastic Certified Analyst certification (desired).
Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900) or Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) (better to have).
ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary).
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics or Databricks (better to have).
Experience with Grafana or similar open-source visualization platforms.
Familiarity with OpenTelemetry (OTel) as a telemetry standard for HCSP platform automation data.
Experience analyzing data from Temporal.io workflow execution APIs or audit logs.
Experience with Terraform state data and infrastructure drift analysis.
Experience operating within a managed services or large enterprise shared services environment.

What We Look For

A data-driven professional with a genuine curiosity for infrastructure platform operations and a talent for turning complex, multi-source operational data into clear and actionable insight. We are looking for an individual who combines strong analytical and visualization skills with practical infrastructure and platform automation awareness — enabling them to serve as the trusted analytical partner to EY's HCSP engineering team and I&O leadership, measuring the platform's impact, identifying improvement opportunities and demonstrating the value of automation at scale.

What We Offer

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you'll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development. Plus, we offer:

Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Werde Teil von Siemens Healthineers! Wir leisten Pionierarbeit im Gesundheitswesen. Für jeden Menschen. Überall. Nachhaltig.

Wir setzen uns für ein inspirierendes und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld in einer globalen Gemeinschaft ein, die Vielfalt und Individualität lebt. Data Analyst*in der Zone Central Western Europe (w/m/d)

In dieser Position wirst Du die digitale Transformation der Zone Central Western Europe (Deutschland, Schweiz & Niederlande) mitgestalten und durch datenbasierte Erkenntnisse, innovative Technologien und intelligente Automatisierungen nachhaltigen Mehrwert im Bereich Finance- & Reporting schaffen.

Wähle den besten Ort für Deine Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Deiner Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.

Noch mehr Flexibilität?
Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Stelle ist in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit mit mind. 30h/Woche zu besetzen.

Arbeitsort: Karl-Heinz-Kaske Straße 5, 91052 Erlangen

Stellenbeschreibung

Du konzipierst und führst Analysen strukturierter und unstrukturierter Daten (z.B. Finanzdaten, technische Informationen und Prozessdaten) aus verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen aus, leitest relevante Erkenntnisse ab und unterstützt bei der Entwicklung datenbasierter Handlungsempfehlungen.
Du entwickelst aussagekräftige Dashboards und Reporting-Lösungen mit Power BI, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und treibst die Digitalisierung sowie Automatisierung bestehender Finanz- & Reporting-Prozesse aktiv voran.
Du entwickelst, implementierst und betreust Python-basierte Automatisierungslösungen für Finanz- und Reporting-Prozesse und sorgst für deren nachhaltige Weiterentwicklung.
Du bist für die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Datenarchitekturen zuständig, optimierst Datenflüsse und bringst deine Fachkenntnisse in den Aufbau skalierbarer Daten- und Analyseplattformen ein.
Du beobachtest technologische Entwicklungen, insbesondere im Bereich Künstliche Intelligenz, bewertest deren Einsatzmöglichkeiten und bringst innovative Lösungsansätze in die Organisation ein.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfährst Du unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/products-services.

Berufserfahrung

Du hast erfolgreich ein technisches oder betriebswirtschaftliches Masterstudium mit Schwerpunkt Data Analytics, Data Science, Machine Learning oder Data Engineering absolviert.
Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Data Analytics, Data Science, Data Engineering oder einem vergleichbaren datengetriebenen Umfeld mit und hast bereits mit Finanz- und Reporting-Prozessen und Daten gearbeitet.
Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in Datenarchitekturen, Datenmanagement und analytischen Methoden mit und verfügst über sehr gute SQL- und/oder Snowflake-Kenntnisse.
Du verfügst über erste Erfahrung und Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung analytischer Lösungen mit Python, nutzt gängige Libraries wie Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn und Scikit-Learn und setzt Visualisierungs-Tools wie Power BI sicher zur zielgruppengerechten Aufbereitung komplexer Sachverhalte ein.
Du arbeitest strukturiert und analytisch, bist mit gängigen Projektmanagementmethoden bestens vertraut und kannst Anforderungen unterschiedlicher Stakeholder*innen sicher priorisieren.
Du kommunizierst fließend auf Deutsch & Englisch.
Du überzeugst durch Eigeninitiative, Lernbereitschaft und Teamgeist und bringst neue Ideen zur Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen, digitalen Lösungen und datengetriebenen Arbeitsweisen ein.

﻿Benefits

Unsere Benefits begleiten Dich in jeder Lebensphase und unterstützen Dein Wohlbefinden, Deine Weiterentwicklung sowie eine gesunde Balance zwischen Beruf und Privatleben. Entdecke die Benefits von Siemens Healthineers im jeweiligen Land.

Wir sind ein Team von mehr als 74.000 engagierten Healthineers in über 70 Ländern. Als führendes Unternehmen der Medizintechnik verschieben wir kontinuierlich die Grenzen des Machbaren, um bessere Ergebnisse und Erfahrungen für Patient*innen zu schaffen – unabhängig davon, wo sie leben oder mit welchen gesundheitlichen Herausforderungen sie konfrontiert sind. Unser Portfolio leistet einen entscheidenden Beitrag zu klinischen Entscheidungen und Prozessen.

Wie wir arbeiten

Wenn Du bei Siemens Healthineers startest, wirst Du Teil eines globalen Teams aus Fachkräften und hochqualifizierten Spezialist*innen aus unterschiedlichen Bereichen, u.a. aus der Wissenschaft, aus dem klinischen Umfeld, aus der Entwicklung und Forschung.

Wir kommen aus unterschiedlichen Kulturen, haben verschiedene Hintergründe, Religionen sowie politische und sexuelle Orientierungen. Gemeinsam arbeiten wir daran, die größten gesundheitlichen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit zu bewältigen und den Zugang zu medizinischer Versorgung weltweit zu verbessern. Dabei verbindet uns ein gemeinsamer Purpose: Wir leisten Pionierarbeit im Gesundheitswesen. Für jeden Menschen. Überall. Nachhaltig.

Daran erkennen wir, dass Du an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert bist und können Dich zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicke hier, um ein Profil anzulegen.

is a leading specialty retailer of menswear, including suits, formalwear, sportswear, and a broad selection of business casual offerings. Our brands include Men's Wearhouse, Jos. A. Bank, Moores and K&G Fashion Superstore,
which offers merchandise for the entire family. We help people love the way they look and feel for their most important moments by delivering personalized products and services through our convenient network of stores and e-commerce sites.

About The Job

We currently have an exciting opportunity for a Sr Data Analyst – Store Analytics,
to join the Tailored Brands Enterprise Analytics team. The Sr Data Analyst – Store Analytics serves as a strategic analytics partner to Stores leadership and enterprise leaders, driving deeper understanding of store performance through diagnostic and exploratory analysis. This role goes beyond reporting to identify root causes of business performance, uncover opportunities, develop actionable recommendations, and influence decisions that improve sales, productivity, customer experience, and operational effectiveness.

The Sr Analyst independently leads complex analyses, develops scalable analytical frameworks, partners closely with business leaders and Data Engineering, and helps shape the evolution of the Store Insights capability.

What You’ll Do | Key Accountabilities

Lead complex diagnostic and ad hoc analyses that identify root causes of store performance, quantify business opportunities, and guide strategic decision-making across Stores.
Independently frame ambiguous business questions, formulate analytical approaches, synthesize multiple data sources, and translate findings into executive-ready recommendations.
Perform root cause analysis to explain sales trends, labor productivity, conversion, customer behavior, and operational performance, developing hypotheses and validating findings through quantitative analysis.
Proactively identify emerging risks and opportunities across the store fleet by monitoring leading performance indicators and conducting exploratory analyses.
Develop and maintain enterprise Power BI dashboards and analytical solutions that enable leaders to self-serve insights while ensuring metric governance and reporting consistency.
Serve as a key analytics partner in the migration from Tableau to Power BI by leading report validation, metric reconciliation, user acceptance testing, and adoption of standardized reporting.
Partner with Data Engineering and business stakeholders to validate semantic-layer logic, metric definitions, data quality, and reporting consistency.
Drive development of scalable Store Insights capabilities by identifying repeatable analytical opportunities, automating recurring analyses, and advancing self-service analytics.
Present findings and recommendations to senior leaders, influencing business strategy through clear storytelling and data-driven insights.
Support store growth analytics initiatives through data preparation, exploratory analysis, performance tracking, and post-investment measurement for new stores, remodels, and market activations.
Develop repeatable analytics workflows that reduce manual reporting effort and improve the speed, quality, and consistency of insight delivery.
Create executive-ready charts, tables, dashboards, and written summaries that communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Apply advanced analytics tools and techniques, including SQL, Power BI, Python, and external data sources, to solve complex business problems and continuously improve analytical capabilities.
Recommend new metrics, analytical approaches, and measurement frameworks that improve how Stores evaluate performance and make decisions.

What You’ll Bring | Skills & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Business, Information Systems, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
8+ years of progressive experience in analytics, business intelligence, consulting, retail analytics, or related quantitative disciplines, with demonstrated success solving complex business problems through data.
Demonstrated experience performing diagnostic, root cause, and exploratory analyses that influenced business decisions.
Proven ability to work independently with minimal direction, prioritize competing initiatives, and manage multiple high-impact analytical projects.
Experience presenting analytical findings to senior leadership and influencing cross-functional stakeholders.
Advanced SQL proficiency with experience optimizing complex queries and working with large enterprise datasets.
Strong experience with Power BI, semantic models, DAX, and modern BI best practices.
Working knowledge of Python, statistical analysis, and modern analytics workflows.
Experience applying statistical methods, experimentation, forecasting, or predictive techniques is preferred.
Experience in retail, multi-unit operations, consumer analytics, or store performance analytics strongly preferred.
Strong attention to detail and demonstrated experience with data validation, KPI governance, and metric consistency.
Ability to synthesize findings into clear written and verbal recommendations for business stakeholders.
Experience working with cross-functional partners to translate business questions into analytical solutions.

Please note that you do not need to qualify for all requirements to be considered. We encourage you to apply if you can meet most of the requirements and are comfortable opening a dialog to be considered.

Work Environment, Physical & Mental Demands

Ability to sit and work at a computer keyboard for extended periods of time
Ability to stoop, kneel, bend at the waist, and reach daily
Able to lift and move up to 25 pounds occasionally
Must utilize visual acuity, speech and hearing, hand and eye coordination and manual dexterity necessary to operate a computer and office equipment

The IS team seeks to hire a highly committed candidate to build and expand our multidimensional programmes across a range of technical and policy areas. Take ownership of at least two research topics in the industrial sustainability and green hydrogen sector pertaining to energy systems modelling and techno-economic assessment.

Drive daily analytical requirements of the team in responding to short-turnaround requests.
Support the team’s policy engagements with central and state government departments through research and data analysis and by preparing reports and presentations.
Support stakeholder engagement and relevant convening, including policy and technical exchanges among government officials, R&D facilities, subject experts, etc.

Strong analytic skills, including quantitative research methods and tools that are fit for purpose.

jobs.description:
GIC is one of the world's largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 offices around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Portfolio Execution & Solutions Group

We have teams in Singapore, London and New York, and we provide a full spectrum of services for the Total Portfolio. These include trading and structured advisory, funding and liquidity management, securities lending, beta management, portfolio rebalancing, applied quantitative research, and counterparty relationship management. We also deliver systematic portfolio solutions and innovation, such as portfolio construction techniques and tail-risk management, to strengthen total portfolio construction and resilience.

Portfolio Exposure & Liquidity

You will be part of a team that manages a unified balance sheet, liquidity, financing and rebalancing. The team comprises Treasury, Securities Finance, Beta Management and the new Exposure & Liquidity Research.

Exposure & Liquidity Research (ELR) is responsible for building the research capabilities, investment models, and decision analytics for Portfolio Managers within the Portfolio Exposure & Liquidity (PEL) division. Our work directly supports the centralised implementation of Total Portfolio requirements across Treasury, Securities Finance, and Beta Management activities to achieve optimal outcomes for GIC.

About the role

We are hiring a Quantitative Research Analyst to contribute towards advancing ELR's research agenda, spanning topics such as Total Portfolio liquidity and financing, rebalancing, securities lending and collateral optimisation, and beta and exposure delivery. As part of a global team, you will contribute quantitative insights to add value to PEL's investment process, platform, and business capabilities.

This role focuses on delivering quantitative research, modelling, and implementation strategies for the management of equity beta portfolios, within PEL's broader remit and objectives. It is suited to a quantitative profile who thrives on integrating rigorous data analysis with market intuition to drive robust decision-making and optimal portfolio outcomes.

What you will do
Develop quantitative tools and analytics to optimise the management and delivery of equity beta exposures, in the context of GIC's Total Portfolio implementation requirements.
Propose research ideas, formulate hypotheses, and conduct data-driven analysis relating to equity index management, to minimise tracking error and capture opportunities due to market inefficiencies.
Contribute to research process design, documentation, and continuous improvement and platforming of the team's quantitative toolkit while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture .
Partner with portfolio managers and traders to translate research findings into practical implementation plans and repeatable decisions for optimal management of equity beta portfolios.
Contribute to broader ELR research topics, including funding and currency hedging, rebalancing strategies, liquidity risk management, and exposure-management decisions.

What you need
5+ years of relevant working experience in equity index rebalancing, index research, ETF or benchmark portfolio management, equity beta, or related investment research.
A degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics or physics, statistics, computer science, finance, or a related field.
Strong Python skills, statistical modelling, back-testing, portfolio construction and optimization, and comfort working with large financial datasets . Candidates with a track record of implementation would be highly desirable.
Sound fundamental understanding of equity markets, index methodologies, corporate actions, market liquidity, transaction costs, tracking error, and portfolio implementation considerations.
Strong communication skills and the ability to explain quantitative work clearly to a non-technical audience including team members, partners and stakeholders.
Strong attention to detail and ability to work collaboratively with business partners.
Experience using AI-assisted development or research tools to build practical solutions for index research, portfolio construction, or investment workflow automation are highly desired.

Work at the Point of Impact

We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact. .

At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. Identity and access management

Data protection and encryption
Assess alignment to frameworks such as:
HITRUST
PCI

ISO/IEC 27001

Enterprise systems

Job Title

Senior Project Manager, Architecture – North America, Data Centers

Department

Design & Construction

Division

Data Center

Reports To

VP, Head of Design, North America

Location:

US, Remote

Position Type

Full-Time, Permanent

About Nscale

NScale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. NScale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

At NScale, our Design & Construction team plays a critical role in delivering data center facilities that are optimized for AI deployments.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an NScaler, you’ll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you’ll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future

About The Role

This role is responsible for managing architectural scope and execution across multiple U.S. data center projects, from early concept through construction support and handover.
Support the development and continuous improvement of Nscale’s data center architectural basis of design standards to enable a repeatable, high-quality delivery across U.S. projects.
Coordinate architectural workstreams across multi-discipline teams (MEP, structural, civil, commissioning, security, network/IT) to ensure the building supports high-density AI infrastructure needs.
Drive schedule, deliverables, quality, and decision-making across internal stakeholders and external A/E partners.
Support architectural due diligence for potential greenfield, brownfield, and colocation opportunities, documenting risks and enabling fast, informed decisions.

What You’ll Be Doing (Responsibilities)

Project Delivery and Design Management

Manage concept, schematic, and detailed design phases for new builds and expansions with a focus on the architectural scope.
Own the architecture portion of the design concepts, deliverable tracking, and issue resolution (RFIs, design clarifications, change management).
Coordinate program requirements, space planning, and room adjacencies with internal stakeholders (Design, Construction, Commissioning, Operations).
Lead design coordination with A/E partners and ensure alignment across disciplines in BIM/clash coordination workflows.
Run design meetings, track action items, and drive closure on open design decisions and interfaces.
Review drawings and specifications for completeness, constructability, maintainability, and compliance with applicable codes and standards.
Support procurement and construction execution through submittal reviews, field issue support, and scope clarifications.

Colocation Leasing Support

Support architectural due diligence for potential colocation sites, including assessment of building constraints, fit, access/logistics, and modification boundaries.
Review landlord/operator documentation and summarize constraints, risks, and required upgrades to support fit-out.
Support negotiation inputs for architectural lease exhibits (fit-out boundaries, permitted modifications, access requirements, and change control requirements).

Site Acquisition Support

Support early-stage site screening by documenting architectural feasibility considerations (massing, setbacks, expansion capacity, access/logistics, staging).
Support architectural due diligence for greenfield and brownfield opportunities, including building suitability (if existing), code pathway risks, and upgrade/retrofit impacts.
Maintain a structured risk register for architecture/CSA items and track mitigations through design and execution.

Required

About You (Skills / Qualifications)

Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Architectural Engineering, or equivalent experience
3+ years of experience managing design and delivery for mission-critical facilities, with significant time on data centers (CSA/architecture scope).
Proven experience coordinating external A/E firms and driving drawing/spec deliverables from concept through construction documents.
Working knowledge of core data center architectural drivers: space planning, maintainability/access, constructability, and life safety coordination.
Experience working with U.S. AHJs and navigating local code environments (state/local variations).
Strong project management skills: schedule control, risk tracking, scope management, and stakeholder communication.

Leadership Profile

Strong presence and decision-making capability
Pragmatic, risk-based leadership style suited to fast-paced construction environments
High judgment in high-consequence scenarios
Ability to challenge delivery teams while maintaining partnership

Equal Opportunities Statement

At NScale, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

The range below reflects the base salary for the position. Actual compensation may vary based on job-related factors such as skill set, experience, education, and location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus, equity, and/or commission programs. Nscale may offer a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, flexible paid time off, parental leave, and retirement plan participation.

Salary Range: $160,000 USD - $190,000 USD

Werfen

Werfen is a growing, family-owned, innovative company founded in 1966 in Barcelona, Spain. We are a worldwide leader in specialized diagnostics in the areas of Hemostasis, Acute Care Diagnostics, Transfusion, Autoimmunity, and Transplant. Through our Original Equipment Manufacturing (OEM) business line, we research, develop, and manufacture customized assays and biomaterials. We operate directly in 30 countries, and in more than 100 territories through distributors. Our Headquarters and Technology Centers are located in the US and Europe, and our workforce is more than 7,000 strong.

Our success comes from a specific focus in these rapidly evolving diagnostic areas, our commitment to customers, and our dedication to innovation and quality. We’re passionate about providing healthcare professionals the most valuable and complete solutions to improve hospital efficiency and enhance patient care.

Overview

Job Summary:

Plan and manage a large multi-functional product development project and/or several small multifunctional product development projects simultaneously. The projects may include large multi-functional projects or a combination of hardware, software, and sustaining projects. The position requires strong, enthusiastic leadership skills in a highly technical medical instrument product development environment. Provide direct supervision to program managers and project managers who are responsible for the projects or major subprojects within the program. Participate in business strategic planning representing current projects and implementing the business strategy. The position requires regular interaction with all functions and levels of the organization from R&D scientists and engineers, marketing/sales, quality/regulatory, and operations, through executive management. Directs the program team and project team(s) in a manner to achieve the business results expected. Forecast program results when requested. Seeks guidance on unusual and complex problems whose solution exceeds the approved project or program boundaries. Authority of position is that required to carry out assigned duties, except where expressly reserved by the senior management personnel or Werfen Corporate/Division Policy.

Responsibilities

Key Accountabilities

Essential Functions

Program Leadership: Provide technical and team leadership to one or more large project team(s) or program team(s). This may include directly leading one of the projects. Leadership entails planning, scheduling, assignment of work, and technical support within the program area. Drive the successful attainment of program goals.
Project Planning and Scheduling: Responsible for project or program planning and scheduling, clarifying and defining the scope of work, utilizing deliverable milestone methods and critical path scheduling, conducting resource planning and allocation, and developing task and project estimates. Generates integrated project plans that meet business objectives and are in compliance with the design control process, while maximizing resource efficiency.
Project Execution and Control: Responsible for conducting regular project or program team status meetings and reviews. Ensures deliverables are completed and documented. Identifies the need for and implements changes to the program and project plans that are within approved program and project boundaries. Plan and conduct major program and supporting project and milestone reviews.
Agile Project Management: Participates in the decision-making process regarding when to employ the Agile methodology. Ensure adequate resources are applied to Agile projects.
Problem Solving Leadership: Responsible for coordination of program and project resources to identify the root cause(s) of program and project issues, and develop and manage a plan to fix, test, and implement an appropriate solution through completion.
Risk Management Leadership: Responsible for ensuring program and project risks, both technical risks and management risks, are identified and appropriate risk mitigation plans are included within the program and project plan. Regularly assess and report the status of overall program risk remaining on a program. Identify risk trends and patterns across the program and develop risk mitigation strategies for systemic risks.
Design Control: Creates and maintains file to current phase ensuring accuracy. Ensure compliance with Design Control practices.
Communication: Responsible for program communication for both within the project team(s) and between the team(s) and executive management.
Vendor Management: Responsible for ensuring adequate oversight and control of vendors providing development, test or technical services that support the project.
Cross Department Collaboration: Responsible to establish communication channels with commercial functions, support team and infrastructure to ensure successful on market change(s) and/or new product introduction. Uses input from commercial functions to influence and execute program plan.
Conflict Resolution: Able to resolve program and project team conflict through the application of good listening skills and negotiating skills. Able to remove oneself from the problem. Fosters a creative, professional climate that will maximize the contributions of the technical staff.
Resource Allocation: Ensures that adequate equipment and material resources are available to advance the program and project(s) and achieve goals and objectives. Works with other program and project managers to ensure the best use of shared resources.
Supervision and Employee Performance: Demonstrated functional management expertise and skills in developing, mentoring and coaching others. Works with functional management participating in skills/gap assessments and conducting coaching for project core team members. Provides direct supervision to Program Managers and Project Managers assigned to the program.
Strategy Development: Lead activities focused on improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the product development processes and procedures.

Budget Managed

Prepares and maintains budgets for the portfolio of programs and projects.
Annual budget between $5 million and $10 million

Networking/Key Relationships

Works with functional management to conduct performance appraisals and coaching for project core team members. Provide regular supervision for assigned Project/Program Manager(s).

To be determined based on department and project needs, to include interactions such as:

Coordination of review of documentation with Quality and Regulatory disciplines
Communication of product changes with Manufacturing / Operations disciplines
Communication of plans and status of projects with Marketing discipline
Communication of plans and status with other programs and projects within R&D

Qualifications

Minimum Knowledge & Experience Required for the Position:

BS in STEM or management discipline of MS/MBA
Additional course work in accounting, business economics, strategy development, resource management and project management is desired
At least 10 years of experience, preferably in product development with at least 5 years of successful technical leadership, project coordination, or project management are required
Experience in the development and release of at least one successful product launch of a medical instrumentation product is desirable
Certification in program management is preferred
Full and comprehensive knowledge of the complete product lifecycle, including all aspects of product development from conception to manufacturing introduction

Skills & Capabilities

Leadership
Functional/technical skills
Analytical Skills
Developing direct reports
Problem-solvingng, conflict management, listening, managing and measuring work
Strong project management skill set and familiarity with project management tools and techniques
Team player, self-motivated, perseverance
Strong oral and written skills
Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Design Control

Travel Requirements

Less than 15% of the time.

new_jobs.title: Principal Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Werfen is a growing, family-owned, innovative company founded in 1966 in Barcelona, Spain. We are a worldwide leader in specialized diagnostics in the areas of Hemostasis, Acute Care Diagnostics, Transfusion, Autoimmunity, and Transplant. Through our Original Equipment Manufacturing (OEM) business line, we research, develop, and manufacture customized assays and biomaterials. We operate directly in 30 countries, and in more than 100 territories through distributors. Our Headquarters and Technology Centers are located in the US and Europe, and our workforce is more than 7,000 strong.

Our success comes from a specific focus in these rapidly evolving diagnostic areas, our commitment to customers, and our dedication to innovation and quality. We’re passionate about providing healthcare professionals the most valuable and complete solutions to improve hospital efficiency and enhance patient care.

Overview

Position Summary:

Plan and manage multiple large multi-functional product development projects simultaneously. The projects may include large multi-functional projects or a combination of hardware, software, and sustaining projects. The position requires strong, enthusiastic leadership skills in a highly technical medical instrument product development environment. Provide direct supervision to program managers and project managers who are responsible for the projects within the program. Assess resource needs and opportunities across programs and support in balancing portfolio risk. Participate in business strategic planning representing current program and implementing the business strategy. The position requires regular interaction with all functions and levels of the organization from R&D scientists and engineers, marketing/sales, quality/regulatory, and operations, through executive management. Directs the program team and project team(s) in a manner to achieve the business results expected. Forecast program results when requested. Seeks guidance on unusual and complex problems whose solution exceeds the approved project or program boundaries. Authority of position is that required to carry out assigned duties, except where expressly reserved by the senior management personnel or Werfen Corporate/Division Policy.

Key Accountabilities

Essential Functions

Program Leadership: Provide technical and team leadership to multiple large project teams or program teams. This may include directly leading one of the projects. Leadership entails planning, scheduling, assignment of work, and technical support within the program area. Drive the successful attainment of program goals.
Project Planning and Scheduling: Responsible for project or program planning and scheduling, clarifying and defining the scope of work, utilizing deliverable milestone methods and critical path scheduling, conducting resource planning and allocation, and developing task and project estimates. Works with other project and program managers as well as functional managers to assess impact across other projects and programs based on resource needs. Generates an integrated project plans that meet business objectives and are in compliance with the design control process, while maximizing resource efficiency.
Project Execution and Control: Responsible for conducting regular project or program team status meetings and reviews. Ensures deliverables are completed and documented. Identifies the need for and implements changes to the program and project plans that are within approved program and project boundaries. Plan and conduct major program and supporting project and milestone reviews.
Agile Project Management: Participates in the decision-making process regarding when to employ the Agile methodology. Ensure adequate resources are applied to Agile projects.
Problem Solving Leadership: Responsible for coordination of program and project resources and to identify individuals outside the specific project or program who would contribute to the identification of root cause(s) of program and project issues, and develop and manage a plan to fix, test, and implement an appropriate solution through completion.
Risk Management Leadership: Responsible for ensuring program and project risks, both technical risks and management risks, are identified and appropriate risk mitigation plans are included within the program and project plan. Regularly assess and report the status of overall program risk remaining on a program. Identify risk trends and patterns across the program and develop risk mitigation strategies for systemic risks. Support periodic assessment of the overall portfolio risk.
Design Control: Creates and maintains file to current phase ensuring accuracy. Ensure compliance with Design Control practices.
Communication: Responsible for program communication for both within the project team(s) and between the team(s) and executive management.
Vendor Management: Responsible for ensuring adequate oversight and control of vendors providing development, test or technical services that support the project. May also participate in the assessment and selection of strategic partners.
Cross Department Collaboration: Responsible to establish communication channels with commercial functions, support team and infrastructure to ensure successful on market change(s) and/or new product introduction. Uses input from commercial functions to influence and execute program plan.
Conflict Resolution: Able to resolve project and program team conflict through the application of listening skills, facilitation skills and negotiating skills. Able to remove oneself from the problem. Provides conflict resolution beyond the technical contributors and extends across the various departments of the organization. Fosters a creative, professional climate that will maximize the contributions of technical and project team members.
Resource Allocation: Ensures that adequate equipment and material resources are available to advance the program and project(s) and achieve goals and objectives. Works with other program and project managers to make the best use for the business of shared resources.
Supervision and Employee Performance: Demonstrated functional management expertise and skills in developing, mentoring and coaching others. Works with functional management participating in skills/gap assessments and conducting performance appraisals and coaching for project core team members. Works with functional management to develop a resourcing strategy to meet the need of the projects or programs for which they are responsible. Provides direct supervision to Program Managers and Project Managers assigned to the program.
Strategy Development: Participates with top management in near-term planning concerning the strategy within a program and the impact across the portfolio.

Budget Managed

Prepares and maintains budgets for the portfolio of programs and projects.
Annual budget between $8 million and $13 million

Networking/Key Relationships

Works with functional management to conduct performance appraisals and coaching for project core team members. Provide regular supervision for assigned Project/Program Manager(s).
To be determined based on department and project needs, to include interactions such as:
Coordination of review of documentation with Quality and Regulatory disciplines
Communication of product changes with Manufacturing / Operations disciplines
Communication of plans and status of projects with Marketing discipline
Communication of plans and status with other programs and projects within R&D

Qualifications

Minimum Knowledge & Experience Required for the Position:

BS in STEM field (engineering, chemistry, physics, etc.), MS/MBA preferred
Additional course work in accounting, business economics, strategy development, resource management and project management is desired
At least 10 years of experience, preferably in product development with at least 7 years of successful technical leadership, project coordination, or project management are required
Experience in the development and release of at least one successful product launch of a medical instrumentation product is desirable
Certification in program management is preferred
Full and comprehensive knowledge of the complete product lifecycle, including all aspects of product development from conception to manufacturing introduction

Skills & Capabilities

Strategic thinking
Leadership
Functional/technical skills
Analytical Skills
Developing direct reports
Problem-solvingng, conflict management, listening, managing and measuring work
Strong project management skill set and familiarity with project management tools and techniques
Team player, self-motivated, perseverance
Strong oral and written skills
Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Design Control

Travel Requirements

20% of the time

The annual base salary range for this role is currently $210,000 to $240,000. Individual employee compensation will ultimately depend on factors including education, relevant experience, skillset, knowledge, and particular business needs.

This role is eligible for medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k plan retirement benefits with an employer match, as well as paid vacation and sick leave. Our sales roles are eligible for participation in a commission plan and our management, and select professional roles, are eligible for a performance-based bonus.
