new_jobs.title: Program Manager-Immunization
new_jobs.description:
Overview

Jhpiego is an international, non-profit health organisation and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high-quality, low-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems. Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong on-the-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real-world systems across 11 thematic domains (Maternal and Newborn Health, Reproductive Health, Nutrition, Immunisation, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, Human Resources for Health, TB and Infectious Diseases, Global Health Security, Women's Cancers, Non-Communicable Diseases, Digital Health).

Jhpiego will work closely with State Governments across eight identified states to strengthen immunization systems for children and adolescents from birth to 16 years of age. Key focus areas include supporting age-appropriate and timely vaccination, strengthening service delivery, facilitating data-driven planning and monitoring, and supporting capacity development and community engagement to ensure every child and adolescent is protected against vaccine-preventable diseases.

Jhpiego is hiring for the position of Program Manager Officer based at Delhi. The position will work closely with the governments, Jhpiego India country office and state teams for implementation of the project activities. The projects focus on to strengthen immunization system across the birth-to-16-years age group . The position will report to Senior Program Manager, Immunization.

Responsibilities

P lanning, coordination and implementation of project activities across the eight identified states, ensuring alignment with project objectives and approved workplans.
Provide strategic and technical leadership to strengthen routine immunization systems and improve age-appropriate vaccination across the birth-to-16-years age group.
Development and implementation of strategies to identify, track and reach left-out and dropout children and adolescents, with a focus on improving immunization coverage, timeliness and completeness.
Coordinate closely with the Ministry, State Health Departments and other key stakeholders to facilitate effective program implementation and address systemic challenges.
Provide technical guidance and oversight to state-level project teams to ensure quality implementation, timely delivery of activities and achievement of program targets.
Lead stakeholder engagement and facilitate national and state-level consultations, review meetings, technical workshops and capacity-building initiatives with government officials and development partners.
Undertake periodic field visits to project states to review implementation progress, provide strategic guidance and support resolution of program bottlenecks.
Work closely with the MERL team to review program performance, monitor key indicators, analyze data and facilitate evidence-based decision-making and course correction.
Oversee program documentation, including good practices, innovations, implementation experiences, success stories and lessons learned.
Lead the preparation and timely submission of donor reports, program updates, technical presentations, workplans and other project deliverables.
Coordinate with internal teams, including Finance, HR, Operations and MERL, to ensure effective resource utilization, compliance and smooth program implementation.
Contribute to resource mobilization and proposal development by identifying emerging opportunities and providing technical inputs for new immunization initiatives.
Undertake other responsibilities as assigned by the supervisor in support of program objectives.

Required Qualifications

Master’s degree in public health (MPH), Health Management, Community Medicine, Epidemiology or Social Sciences. Candidates with a medical background (MBBS/BDS/BAMS/BHMS) along with a relevant postgraduate qualification will be preferred.
8-10 years of relevant experience in public health, immunization or health systems strengthening programs.
Demonstrated experience in planning, implementation and monitoring of immunization programs preferably at state and district levels.
Experience working closely with government health systems, particularly MoHFW and development partners.
Demonstrated experience in stakeholder coordination, community engagement and working with frontline health workers and community platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

Strong program planning, implementation, coordination and problem-solving skills.
Ability to analyze program data, identify performance gaps and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
Strong stakeholder engagement, interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with government officials, development partners and community stakeholders.
Good documentation, report writing, presentation and knowledge-management skills.
Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, and analyzing data of immunization program.
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team.

Willingness to undertake frequent field visits and travel to project states and districts as required

Rattaché.e au directeur (trice) de concession, vous êtes garant de la fiabilité du pilotage du programme de déploiement FTTH : planification, suivi de la production, reporting, maîtrise budgétaire et qualité des données dans le cadre de la Délégation de Service Public (DSP) pour le Très Haut Débit à Mayotte.

Vos Principales Missions Sont

■ Pilotage et suivi de la production

– Suivre l'avancement du déploiement par zone et par commune à chaque étape : études, accès aux appuis aériens et au génie civil, travaux, raccordements NRO/PM/PBO, recette et mise en commercialisation.

– Consolider les indicateurs de production : prises construites, prises raccordables, taux de réussite en recette, délais par phase, volumes de réserves.

– Identifier les points de blocage (appuis à remplacer, autorisations, approvisionnement en matériel, aléas climatiques) et suivre les plans d'action associés avec les Chefs de Projet.

■ Planification et gestion des ressources

– Construire et tenir à jour le planning global du programme, en intégrant les dépendances entre études, autorisations, travaux et liaisons terrestres et maritimes.

– Suivre la capacité des sous-traitants et des équipes internes, et alerter en cas d'écart entre charge et ressources.

– Anticiper les contraintes logistiques propres à l'insularité : délais d'acheminement du matériel, disponibilité de la main-d'œuvre qualifiée.

■ Gouvernance et reporting

– Produire les tableaux de bord hebdomadaires et mensuels à destination de la direction et des instances de gouvernance.

– Préparer et contribuer au reporting contractuel de la DSP auprès du Conseil départemental, autorité délégante.

– Préparer les comités de pilotage et revues de production, rédiger les comptes rendus et assurer le suivi des décisions.

– Préparer les éléments justificatifs nécessaires au suivi des financements publics (État, FEDER, Département).

■ Suivi budgétaire et contractuel

– Suivre les coûts par prise et par phase, les engagements, les bons de commande et la facturation des prestataires, en lien avec le contrôle de gestion.

– Suivre les jalons et engagements contractuels de la DSP, ainsi que l'application des clauses contractuelles avec les prestataires et partenaires.

– Alerter sur les dérives de coûts ou de délais et proposer des mesures correctives.

■ Qualité des données et amélioration continue

– Garantir la cohérence des données de déploiement entre les outils (SIG, outils de suivi de production, référentiel d'adresses) et le respect des formats d'échange (Grace THD, IPE).

– Contribuer à la fiabilisation de l'adressage et au suivi des déclarations de prises raccordables auprès de l'Arcep et des opérateurs commerciaux.

– Définir, diffuser et faire évoluer les standards de pilotage (modèles, processus, outils) et capitaliser sur les retours d'expérience.

new_jobs.description:
About Invent

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

Help build Sweden’s next-generation emergency network – and strengthen societal resilience when it matters most.

Capgemini Invent supports the Swedish Civil Defense and Resilience Agency (MCF) in one of the country’s most important telecom transformation programs: SWEN, the Swedish Emergency Network. SWEN is the next generation of Sweden’s national communication system for public safety, civil defense and critical public services – bringing secure, 5G-based mission-critical voice, data and video (MCX) to the organizations that keep society running.

We are looking for a Project Leader who combines structured delivery leadership with a genuine interest in telecom and critical communications. You will lead project workstreams, keep plans, risks and stakeholders aligned, and turn ambitious goals into measurable results.

What you will do:

Plan, lead and follow up project workstreams end to end – scope, schedule, budget, resources and dependencies
Build and maintain project plans, roadmaps and milestones, applying agile, hybrid or traditional delivery methods as appropriate
Identify, track and mitigate risks, issues and dependencies, and bring decisions to the right governance forums
Run steering group and working meetings, and prepare clear status reports and decision material for senior client stakeholders
Coordinate cross-functional teams – client experts, technical specialists, suppliers and Capgemini colleagues – to keep delivery on track
Manage change requests, quality assurance and acceptance of project deliverables
Grow client relationships and coach junior consultants in project management best practice

Your Profile

At least 5 years of experience leading projects or workstreams, gained in areas such as project management, PMO, IT delivery, consulting, business analysis or business transformation
Background from sectors such as IT, telecom, defense, the public sector or other complex, regulated environments
Hands-on experience with project planning, risk and issue management, stakeholder management and status reporting
A relevant university degree in a field such as engineering, business, economics, computer science or information systems, or equivalent experience
Structured, proactive and self-driven, with strong communication skills and the ability to build trust with senior stakeholders
Fluent English, spoken and written
EU citizenship and the ability to pass a security screening, due to client security requirements

Nice to Have

Knowledge of telecommunications or mission-critical communications (MCX), such as public safety networks, LTE/5G or 3GPP MCX standards
A project management certification
Experience from public sector or critical infrastructure programs, or from telecom operators or vendors
Swedish and/or French language skills

No prior experience in mission-critical communications is needed – we will help you build that domain knowledge through onboarding, training and working alongside our experienced specialists.

What You'll Love About Working Here

Contribute to a program of national importance – strengthening the communications that Sweden's emergency services and public safety actors rely on, especially in a crisis
Build expertise in mission-critical communications, a fast-growing field as public safety moves towards secure, broadband and standards-based MCX services
Learn from and collaborate with Capgemini's network of telecom, MCX, cybersecurity and public sector specialists across Capgemini Invent and the Capgemini Group
Take on real responsibility early, with direct exposure to senior client stakeholders and program governance
Develop your project leadership career through learning programs, coaching and a community of experienced project leaders

new_jobs.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Atlanta, GA, USA; Austin, TX, USA
. Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Education, Instructional Design, Educational Technology, Business Administration, Communications, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
4 years of experience in program or project management, educational technology integration, or digital learning development.
Experience managing external digital learning agencies, content vendors, or creative suppliers from project scoping through final asset delivery.
Experience building and structuring courses using digital authoring tools (e.g., Evolve Authoring, Articulate 360/Storyline) and deploying digital learning packages (SCORM/xAPI) into enterprise Learning Management Systems (LMS/LXP).

Preferred qualifications:

Master's degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, or a related field.
Deep understanding of adult learning theory (ADDIE, SAM) applied to legal and compliance training.
Managing complex, multi-vendor learning programs from inception through global corporate deployment.
Designing reusable templates and systems balancing strict legal requirements with engaging UX.
Integrating multimedia production and innovative Generative AI tools into learning workflows.
Applying digital accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA) and conducting technical audits.

About The Job

The Risk, Compliance and Integrity (RCI) Education and Awareness team promotes an ethical and compliant culture across Google by creating innovative, accessible, and user-centered learning experiences. Our mission is to empower Googlers and extended workforce members worldwide to understand key legal, regulatory, and policy requirements, transforming complex compliance mandates into engaging, intuitive, and effective digital education.

As a Learning Program Manager, you will serve as the central program manager and technical integration lead for the compliance education content team. In this role, you will operate at the intersection of instructional design, educational technology, and project execution bridging the gap between high-level regulatory expectations and digital course delivery. You will orchestrate end-to-end development roadmaps with leading external digital learning agencies and suppliers, implement scalable course authoring frameworks in tools such as Evolve Authoring, and oversee technical packaging, testing, and deployment into Google's enterprise Learning Management Systems (LMS / Intellum). Furthermore, you will drive the integration of multimedia and AI-assisted learning tools (such as conversational simulations and AI coaching assistants) across our global compliance curricula.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $111000 - $159000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Lead relationships with external agencies, managing roadmaps, budgets, and milestone schedules to ensure timely curriculum delivery.
Establish authoring frameworks, overseeing SCORM/xAPI packaging, LMS deployment, and multimedia integration including Generative AI tools.
Lead instructional reviews, QA testing, and digital accessibility audits (WCAG 2.1 AA) on all supplier deliverables.
Streamline content intake and legal review workflows with SMEs while coordinating asset cataloging and ticket resolution with extended workforce solutions partners.
Partner with data teams to monitor course completions, analyze user feedback, and drive continuous curriculum improvement.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. new_jobs.description:
Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today’s needs and tomorrow’s next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we’re living in and that we have the power to shape.

Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality.

Sandisk has two facilities recognized by the World Economic Forum as part of the Global Lighthouse Network for advanced 4IR innovations. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward.

Description

The Program Manager - Workplace Modernization & Employee Experience leads to the end-to-end development and delivery of a strategic portfolio of workplace modernization, facilities transformation, employee experience, and sustainability programs. The role converts business and employee needs into prioritized roadmaps, approved business cases, funded programs, and measurable outcomes. It owns program strategy, portfolio governance, capital and operating planning, executive reporting, change adoption, and benefits realization, while IFM partners and other service providers remain accountable for day-to-day facilities operations, maintenance execution, and contracted service delivery.

Essential And Responsibilities

Workplace Modernization & Facilities Transformation
Develop and maintain a multi-year workplace modernization and facilities transformation roadmap aligned with site strategy, growth plans, operational resilience, and employee needs.
Lead modernization programs from concept and feasibility through design, funding approval, procurement, implementation, transition, and post-implementation review.
Translate site need clear project charters, scopes, design briefs, delivery strategies, milestones, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.
Integrate workplace functionality, accessibility, safety, technology enablement, maintainability, and user experience into program requirements.
Coordinate with Engineering, EHS, Security, IT, Finance, Procurement, HR, site leadership, and business stakeholders to deliver cross-functional transformation outcomes.
Employee Experience & Workplace Programs
Use employee feedback, service data, workplace observations, utilization trends, and business priorities to define high-impact workplace experience programs.
Lead programs covering employee amenities, wellbeing, inclusive workplace improvements, collaboration spaces, canteen and welfare facilities, mobility, and workplace services.
Create change management, communication, engagement, and adoption plans for major workplace changes.
Establish experience measures and service outcomes, including satisfaction, adoption, accessibility, response quality, and sustained usage.
Portfolio Management, Capital Planning & Business Cases
Own the workplace program portfolio, including intake, prioritization, sequencing, dependency management, resource planning, and portfolio-level risk management.
Develop robust business cases with problem statements, options analysis, cost estimates, benefits, risks, implementation approaches, and financial justification.
Prepare and maintain annual and multi-year capital and operating plans, funding requests, forecasts, cash-flow profiles, and commitment tracking.
Monitor portfolio health across scope, budget, schedule, quality, risk, benefits, and stakeholder readiness, escalating decisions and corrective actions promptly.
Maintain executive dashboards and portfolio reviews that clearly communicate status, financial position, key decisions, risks, and realized value.
Program Execution & Benefits Realization
Establish integrated program plans, governance forums, decision rights, workstreams, stage gates, controls, and reporting standards.
Drive delivery against approved scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, and operational continuity requirements.
Define program benefits, baselines, targets, owners, measurement methods, and realization timing before implementation approval.
Conduct readiness reviews, commissioning and handover governance, lessons learned, and post-implementation benefit reviews.
Intervene when delivery deviates from plan and lead recovery actions, scope decisions, risk mitigation, and stakeholder alignment.
Sustainability & Workplace Innovation
Embed sustainability objectives into workplace programs, including energy and water efficiency, waste reduction, responsible materials, circularity, and lifecycle value.
Develop and deliver sustainability initiatives with defined baselines, targets, implementation plans, measurement methods, and verified outcomes.
Evaluate workplace technologies and innovative service models through structured pilots, value assessment, scalability reviews, and deployment plans.
Partner with EHS, Engineering, Procurement, Finance, and service providers to support site and corporate sustainability commitments.
Financial Management & Executive Reporting
Own program-level budget planning, cost control, forecasting, variance analysis, funding utilization, and financial reporting.
Validate commercial assumptions, estimates, proposals, change requests, and total-cost-of-ownership implications with Finance and Procurement.
Prepare concise executive updates, investment papers, steering committee materials, decision briefs, and escalation reports.
Ensure decisions, approvals, financial commitments, changes, risks, and benefits are documented and traceable.
Strategic Governance, Risk & Assurance
Apply fit-for-purpose program governance and assurance controls proportionate to program scale, complexity, and risk.
Identify and manage strategic delivery risks, including funding, schedule, operational disruption, stakeholder adoption, safety, compliance, vendor capacity, and benefit leakage.
Ensure programs incorporate applicable legal, EHS, security, accessibility, business continuity, and corporate requirements in partnership with the accountable subject-matter owners.
Use audits, reviews, benchmarks, service data, and lessons learned to strengthen delivery standards and portfolio performance.
CREW Strategic Leadership & Program Delivery
CREW owns strategy, program sponsorship, portfolio prioritization, business cases, funding governance, stakeholder alignment, design intent, delivery assurance, executive reporting, and benefits realization.
IFM partners and other appointed service providers own contracted operational execution, including routine operations, preventive and corrective maintenance, manpower deployment, work-order management, inspections, service-level delivery, and operational records.
The Program Manager defines outcomes and governance, assures delivery, resolves cross-functional barriers, and holds providers accountable without replacing the service provider’s site operational management responsibilities.
Escalate material service-provider performance gaps through contractual governance and require documented recovery plans, owners, milestones, and closure evidence.
Stakeholder, Vendor & Change Leadership
Build senior stakeholder alignment across site leadership and corporate functions, and facilitate timely decisions on priorities, funding, scope, and risk.
Develop scopes of work and evaluation criteria for consultants, contractors, and program partners in collaboration with Procurement and technical stakeholders.
Govern vendor performance against deliverables, milestones, quality, commercial terms, and expected outcomes.
Lead structured communications and change adoption to minimize disruption and embed new workplace solutions.

Location:
London, hybrid (Must have right to work in the UK)

About ThreatSpike

ThreatSpike is the AI-Managed IT Department. We deliver fully managed IT and complete security as one platform, one team, one fixed price, replacing the legacy MSP model entirely. Every business we work with gets world-class IT from day one, gets measurably better every week, and never has to manage a vendor relationship again.

We are the first company to operate as both the technology vendor and the service provider simultaneously. Agentic AI runs through every layer of how we operate, and our forward-deployed engineers execute against a structured roadmap in our customers’ environments every day. Today, ThreatSpike protects more than 400 customers across 90 countries, and following our Series A we are growing fast.

The Role

As a Project Manager at ThreatSpike, you will deliver small to medium-sized customer projects on time and to a high standard. You will be placed across multiple accounts, usually reporting into an Engagement Manager, and you will be the day-to-day delivery voice for the customer.

You will work within our PMO function, balancing several engagements at once while keeping plans, risks and communications tight. For smaller new customers, you may also be put forward to lead onboarding, becoming the first main representative of the ThreatSpike Delivery team and setting the tone for the relationship.

What you’ll be doing

Delivering small to medium-sized projects on established customer accounts, from kick-off through to handover into continuous operations, on time and to quality
Working alongside an Engagement Manager, taking ownership of project plans, delivery milestones and day-to-day customer communication
Balancing multiple engagements at once as part of the PMO function, prioritising effectively as demands shift
Identifying, logging and reporting risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies (RAID) and escalating them early, with clear options, for steering
Producing clear, accurate status reporting for customers and internal stakeholders
Selecting and applying the right delivery approach for each project, whether waterfall, Agile/Scrum or a hybrid
Coordinating across ThreatSpike’s internal teams (engineering, security operations, service delivery, product) so the customer gets a seamless experience and our forward-deployed engineers are set up to succeed
Building strong, trusted relationships with customers and colleagues alike
Where appropriate, leading the onboarding of small to medium-sized new customers as the first main ThreatSpike Delivery representative
Following and helping to improve ThreatSpike’s delivery playbook, tooling and governance, and feeding back what you learn on live projects

About You: experience and skills

Essential:

Around 3–5 years’ project management experience in IT environments, with a track record of delivering technical projects to time and quality
A background in AI, infrastructure or cybersecurity delivery
Working knowledge of project management frameworks, including waterfall and Scrum/Agile, and the judgement to choose the right one for the project
Experience running several projects or workstreams at the same time without letting quality or communication slip
Confidence in RAID management and in reporting risks and issues clearly to steering groups
Enough technical understanding to engage with engineers, understand dependencies and spot when something doesn’t add up
Excellent written and verbal communication, tailored to the audience

Nice to have:

Experience in managed services, enterprise SaaS or cybersecurity delivery
Experience leading or supporting customer onboarding
A recognised project management qualification (for example PRINCE2, PMP, APM or Scrum/Agile certification)
Experience working with customers across multiple time zones

About You: education and personal attributes

Degree educated with a 2:1 or higher; no specific subject is required
An excellent team player and collaborator who builds trust quickly with colleagues across engineering, security and service delivery
Skilled at forming relationships between customers and colleagues, and comfortable being the first face of ThreatSpike Delivery to a new customer
Organised and self-directed, able to take an ambiguous goal, structure it into a plan and drive it to completion
Comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where priorities shift and the playbook is still being written

What you get

Direct exposure to a range of customer accounts and project types across AI, infrastructure and cybersecurity
The chance to work closely with Engagement Managers and the wider Delivery team in a fast-scaling, category-defining business
Early opportunities to lead customer onboarding and build your own customer relationships
Hybrid working from our London, Mayfair office, with travel to customer sites across the UK as projects require (many are in London, but not all)

Senior Project Manager / Technical Program Manager

We're looking for a seasoned Senior Project Manager/Technical Program Manager
to own the coordination and delivery of complex, cross-functional software initiatives. This role sits at the intersection of Agile delivery management and operational execution. You'll be equally comfortable running a sprint retro and troubleshooting a live demo in front of senior executives.

The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, brings structure to fast-moving technical teams, and is fluent in using AI tools to scale their own effectiveness.

Key Responsibilities
Cross-functional delivery coordination

Serve as the central point of coordination across software development, product management, and operations teams, ensuring deliverables are scoped, tracked, and landed on schedule.

End-to-end SW program ownership

Manage delivery of technical initiatives spanning infrastructure builds, automated test tooling, telemetry/debug systems, and large-scale data pipelines, often supporting hardware/device validation and bring-up processes.

Quality and readiness gatekeeping

Act as a checkpoint between engineering completion and downstream production or factory release, ensuring software meets validation and calibration standards before sign-off.

Operational management

Take hands-on ownership of operational functions such as tech support workflows, community/user engagement programs, and device or fleet management, not just software timelines, but the people and processes that support them.

Data pipeline alignment

Coordinate closely between teams generating data and teams consuming it (e.g., research or product teams), ensuring outputs match evolving downstream requirements, including transitions between different data sourcing methodologies.

Executive-facing demo management

Plan, script, and run live product demos for senior leadership and executive audiences, including real-time troubleshooting and contingency management to ensure flawless execution under pressure.

AI-native reporting and tracking

Build or leverage AI-powered agents and dashboards to automatically track deliverables, flag risks, and generate stakeholder-ready status reports, reducing manual reporting overhead and improving visibility.

Stakeholder communication

Translate technical progress and blockers into clear, concise updates for both engineering leadership and non-technical executive stakeholders.

Process innovation

In situations with no existing playbook, prototype new workflows and approaches, then codify learnings into standard operating procedures (SOPs) that scale across the broader team or organization.

Team leadership

Manage and mentor a small team or group of coordinators/contributors supporting operational functions, fostering an AI-forward, efficiency-driven culture.

Requirements

8+ years of experience in technical program/project management, ideally within software engineering or hardware/software integration environments
Strong working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies, with proven experience running sprint ceremonies, backlog grooming, and iterative delivery cycles
Demonstrated experience coordinating multiple engineering teams simultaneously, with strong prioritization and risk management skills
Comfort operating in high-visibility, high-pressure settings (executive demos, live troubleshooting)
Familiarity with AI/automation tools for reporting, tracking, or workflow optimization
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to flex between technical and executive audiences

PMP, PMI-ACP, SAFe, or equivalent certification
Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science or IT or Business Admin
Experience with hardware/software co-development environments (e.g., device calibration, chip bring-up, factory validation)

Cybersecurity, Endpoint and M365, Cloud and Network, IT Service Management, ITIL Process and Training experience preferred

Are looking for an exciting opportunity to make an impact and advance your career?

THE POSITION

The State of Connecticut , Department of Mental Health and Addiction Services (DMHAS) is now hiring for a Business Integrity and Operational Efficiency Program Manager (State Program Manager) to join their team! This position will be accountable for data-driven fiscal oversight, business process redesign, internal controls, operational productivity, and expenditure management in high-cost nonclinical departments.

HIGHLIGHTS

FACILITY: Connecticut Valley Hospital (CVH)
UNIT: CVH Administration
LOCATION: 1000 Silver Street, Middletown, CT
SCHEDULE: Full-Time, 40 Hours per Week, First Shift, Monday through Friday, 8:00am - 4:30pm

Professional growth and development opportunities

Provide hospital-wide leadership in data-driven financial oversight, business process redesign, internal controls, and compliance monitoring; and
Work collaboratively with the COO, Finance, and departmental managers to identify inefficiencies, implement sustainable process improvements, and establish standardized accountability measures.

About Us

DMHAS is a health care agency whose mission is to promote the overall health and wellness of persons with behavioral health needs through an integrated network of holistic, comprehensive, effective, and efficient services and supports that foster dignity, respect, and self-sufficiency in those we serve.

CVH opened in 1868 as the State’s public hospital for the treatment of persons with mental illness. Today, CVH is the largest of DMHAS facilities, and includes 17 inpatient units over two campuses (Middletown and Hartford). The hospital includes both a general psychiatry and addiction services units. CVH provides comprehensive inpatient and outpatient psychiatric care and substance abuse treatment, including treatment for pregnant women and persons with dual diagnoses. Specialty areas include geriatric and special services, an integrated network of comprehensive mental health services for older adults and young adult services. The facility also runs the Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI) program which addresses the needs of TBI survivors, including reintegration into community living, independent living skills development, vocational and educational training, psychiatric, cognitive and neurological assessment and treatment, speech and physical rehabilitation as well as individual and family counseling.

We are looking for a Data Analyst Manager to build and lead our analytics function. This role goes beyond reporting. You will build the team and capability that scale with a high-growth consumer brand.

Data Foundation:

a. Bring together sales, inventory, marketing, finance and operations data into one reliable view.
b. Pull in data from quick commerce platforms, marketplaces, modern trade, general trade and the D2C website.
c. Define common KPIs and metrics so that every team works off the same numbers.
d. Put checks in place so that data is accurate before it reaches dashboards and reports.

a. Partner with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance and Leadership to turn business questions into clear analyses.
b. Track channel performance, SKU velocity, availability, pricing, promotions and trade spend effectiveness.
c. Understand customer behaviour: repeat purchase, retention, order value and channel-level profitability.
d. Support marketing teams with ROI and campaign performance analysis.
e. Support planning with demand, sell-through and inventory insights.

AI Workflows & Use Case Building:

a. Identify where AI can create the most value across functions (sales, marketing, supply chain, finance, customer experience) and prioritise use cases by impact and ease of execution.
b. Build AI-enabled workflows that automate repetitive work, such as report generation, channel reconciliations, deduction checks and alerts for unusual numbers.
c. Create simple AI tools for business teams, such as asking questions of company data in plain language and getting automated summaries.
d. Take use cases from idea to working prototype to everyday use, with clear owners and success measures.
e. Evaluate AI tools and vendors with attention to cost, accuracy and data security.
f. Train teams to use AI well and set clear guidelines for responsible use of company data.

Dashboards & Reporting:

a. Own leadership dashboards and regular management reports on revenue, margins, growth and channel health.
b. Replace manual spreadsheets with automated reporting.
c. Choose and set up the right tools for the stage of the business.

Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management:

a. Lead, mentor and develop a team of analysts.
b. Prioritise the analytics and AI roadmap based on business impact, and set clear delivery standards.
c. Build a culture of data-driven decision-making across the organisation.
d. Present insights and recommendations to the leadership team in a clear, concise manner.

Governance & Process Building:

a. Set up data access, documentation and quality standards, including guidelines for AI use.
b. Design simple processes for data requests, report ownership and refresh cycles.
c. Build processes that scale with growth and reduce reliance on manual work.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Statistics, Economics, Commerce or a related field. MBA is a plus.
4–7 years of experience in business or data analytics, with at least 1–2 years managing or mentoring analysts.
Experience in FMCG / D2C / E-commerce / Quick Commerce / Consumer Tech will be a strong advantage.

Hands-on experience using AI tools and automation to solve real business problems. Prior experience building AI-enabled workflows is a strong plus.
Strong understanding of consumer business metrics such as repeat rate, order value, margins and promotion impact.
Exposure to quick commerce and marketplace data (Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, Amazon, Flipkart) is a plus.
Structured, hypothesis-driven problem solving with strong communication and stakeholder influencing skills.
i. A builder mindset: comfortable going from idea to working prototype quickly and measuring real business impact.
j. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial startup environment.

Overview

Cyber Security Analyst – SOC (Cloud Incident Response)

Location:
Hyderabad, India Work Arrangement:
On-Site

About The Role

As a SOC Cyber Security Analyst at Hyland, you will investigate and respond to security incidents escalated from the associate level, with a strong focus on cloud incident response and threat detection across AWS and Azure. You will perform in-depth analysis, contain threats using established playbooks, escalate complex cases to the senior level, and help improve detections and automation — while supporting and guiding associate level analysts in a collaborative and innovative security organization.

This role is a great fit for a hands-on analyst with a solid investigative mindset who is ready to grow toward senior incident response and threat hunting.

Technology Tools

SIEM & XDR: Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, EDR/XDR platforms
Cloud Security: AWS CloudTrail, AWS GuardDuty, AWS Security Hub, Microsoft Defender for Cloud
Identity & Access: Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Azure Activity/Sign-in/Audit Logs
Automation & Scripting: Python, PowerShell, SOAR platforms
Threat Intelligence: MITRE ATT&CK framework, Threat Intelligence platforms (TIPs)

Your Role Responsibilities – Here's What You'll Do

Triage, investigate, and respond to security incidents escalated from the associate level, performing root cause analysis and containment across cloud (AWS, Azure), on-premises, and hybrid environments
Investigate cloud security events — including suspicious IAM and Entra ID activity, compromised credentials, anomalous API activity, and malicious OAuth app consent — using CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Azure Activity/Sign-in/Audit logs, Defender, and Sentinel
Execute and refine incident response playbooks, escalating complex or high-severity incidents to the senior level with clear evidence and timelines
Tune detection rules and use cases (KQL, SPL) to reduce false positives, improve alert quality, and recommend new detections
Leverage Python, PowerShell, and SOAR playbooks to automate repetitive investigation and response tasks, applying AI-assisted triage where available
Mentor and support associate level analysts through knowledge sharing, case reviews, and on-the-job coaching, while actively contributing to post-incident reviews and security documentation

Role Essentials – What You'll Need

Bachelor's degree in Cyber Security, IT, Computer Science, or equivalent experience
4+ years in SOC, Incident Response, Threat Detection, or Security Operations — including at least 1–2 years of hands-on experience investigating cloud security incidents
Proven experience investigating incidents in AWS and Azure/Microsoft Entra ID using CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Azure Activity/Sign-in/Audit logs, Defender, and Sentinel
Hands-on proficiency with SIEM, EDR/XDR, and threat intelligence tools across Windows and Linux/Unix environments

new_jobs.title: IT Security Analyst (Intermediate)
new_jobs.description:
Position Title: IT Security Analyst (Intermediate)
Location: India Haryana
Working Hours: Rotational Shift as per 24*7-365 Day Working Environment
(Shifts will be in Evening/Night as per time zones in IST)

The IT Security Analyst is responsible for protecting GuestTek’s internal technology environment by monitoring security controls, reducing risk, supporting incident response, and strengthening the security of business applications, cloud services, endpoints, identities, and infrastructure. This intermediate role works closely with IT Infrastructure, application owners, vendors, and business teams to maintain practical security controls while supporting reliable day-to-day operations.

Responsibilities:

Security Operations & Incident Response

• Monitor security alerts, logs, dashboards, and system notifications; investigate suspicious activity and escalate confirmed or high-risk events in accordance with established procedures.
• Participate in the containment, investigation, recovery, and documentation of security incidents, including phishing, malware, account compromise, unauthorized access, and data exposure concerns.
• Maintain incident records, timelines, evidence, lessons learned, and follow-up actions while preserving confidentiality and appropriate handling of sensitive information.
• Manage and maintain centralized syslog collection from firewalls, switches, wireless controllers, servers, VPNs, and other infrastructure; ensure log sources are onboarded, time-synchronized, retained according to policy, and reviewed for security events, anomalies, and audit purposes.
• Assist with security monitoring improvements, alert tuning, operational runbooks, and repeatable response procedures.
Identity, Access & Microsoft 365 Security

• Administer and review security controls across Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Intune, and Microsoft Defender.
• Support identity and access controls, including multifactor authentication, Conditional Access, role-based access, privileged access, guest/external access, and account lifecycle reviews.
• Perform periodic access reviews and work with system owners to remove unnecessary, inactive, excessive, or conflicting permissions.
• Investigate authentication, mailbox, collaboration, and account-related security events and recommend corrective actions.
Endpoint, Cloud & Infrastructure Security

• Support endpoint protection, device compliance, secure configuration, encryption, patching, application control, and vulnerability remediation for Windows devices and servers.
• Assist with firewall, VPN, network, wireless, cloud, server, and backup security reviews in collaboration with infrastructure specialists.
• Review security posture and configuration findings for Azure, AWS, SaaS platforms, and other hosted systems used by the organization.
• Validate remediation activities and document accepted risks, exceptions, compensating controls, and outstanding actions.
Vulnerability & Risk Management

• Coordinate vulnerability scanning, triage findings, prioritize remediation based on severity and business impact, and track issues through closure.
• Assist with secure configuration baselines, patch compliance reporting, risk assessments, third-party security reviews, and audit evidence collection.
• Monitor relevant threat and vulnerability information and translate it into practical actions for GuestTek systems and tools.
• Support periodic testing of backups, recovery procedures, security controls, and response readiness.
Business Systems, SaaS & Vendor Security

• Partner with application owners to assess the security of business systems, integrations, service accounts, APIs, and administrative access.
• Participate in security reviews for new tools, major changes, vendor access, data integrations, and technology implementations before production use.
• Coordinate remediation activities with vendors and internal owners, ensuring security requirements, responsibilities, and evidence are documented.
• Maintain an inventory of security-relevant systems, owners, administrative accounts, integrations, and key controls.
Governance, Awareness & Documentation

• Create and maintain security procedures, standards, knowledge articles, asset records, diagrams, risk records, and control documentation.
• Support policy compliance, internal reviews, customer or audit requests, and security awareness initiatives.
• Support ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 1, and SOC 2 audit and assurance activities by coordinating evidence collection, maintaining control documentation, responding to auditor requests, tracking findings, and working with control owners to complete remediation actions.
• Provide practical guidance to employees and technical teams on secure use of systems, phishing prevention, password and access practices, and incident reporting.
• Contribute to change management, service management, problem management, and continuous improvement activities.
QUALIFICATIONS

Required

• Diploma or degree in information security, information technology, computer science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
• Three to five years of progressive IT experience, including at least two years working with security operations, systems administration, cloud security, endpoint security, or identity and access management.
• Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 and Entra ID security, including authentication, permissions, audit logs, Conditional Access, and security investigation workflows.
• Working knowledge of endpoint security, vulnerability management, Windows security, networking, firewalls, VPNs, TCP/IP, DNS, cloud services, and common SaaS security risks.
• Ability to investigate technical issues methodically, assess risk, document evidence clearly, and communicate findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Professional written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, discretion, and sound judgment when handling sensitive information.
Preferred / Assets
•
Experience with Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365, Microsoft Sentinel, Intune, Purview, or comparable security platforms.
• Experience with Palo Alto firewalls, Cisco or Meraki networking, vulnerability scanners, SIEM platforms, EDR tools, email security, and cloud security posture management.
• Familiarity with Azure and AWS security controls, PowerShell, syslog and centralized logging platforms (such as OpenSearch or Graylog), log analysis, API integrations, and automation of routine security tasks.
• Knowledge of security frameworks and practices such as CIS Controls, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO/IEC 27001, Zero Trust, least privilege, and secure change management.
• Experience supporting internal or external audits and assurance reviews, including ISO/IEC 27001 and SOC 1 or SOC 2, with an understanding of control evidence, audit readiness, findings management, and remediation tracking.
• Relevant certification such as CompTIA Security+, Microsoft Security Operations Analyst, Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator, SSCP, GSEC, or equivalent.
• Experience working in a global organization and coordinating across time zones, business functions, vendors, and technical teams.
PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

• Analytical and curious, with a strong interest in understanding how systems, users, and integrations create or reduce risk.
• Practical and solutions-focused, able to balance security requirements with business and operational needs.
• Organized and dependable, with strong ownership, follow-through, and attention to detail.
• Calm under pressure and able to manage competing priorities during investigations or service-impacting events.
• Collaborative and approachable, with the ability to build trust and explain security concepts in clear language.
• Committed to continuous learning and staying current with evolving threats, technologies, and security practices.

new_jobs.title: AVP/VP, Data Analyst, Operational Risk Management
new_jobs.description:
GIC is one of the world's largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 locations around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world's industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we Work at the Point of Impact for Singapore's financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide.

Risk & Performance Management Department

In Risk & Performance Management Department (RPMD), we work collaboratively across teams to identify and address potential blind spots, ensuring that all relevant risks are considered and duly addressed.

Operational Risk Management

The Operational Risk Management (ORM) team is responsible for driving and managing the corporate operational risk management programme within GIC. Operational risk tools and analytics are developed to better inform management about the operational risk landscape. We are looking for a dynamic and self-motivated individual to join the team as an Assistant Vice President/ Vice President, focusing on data analytics to strengthen risk and control oversight.

What impact can you make in this role?

You will be part of a team responsible for the independent assessment, measurement, monitoring and reporting of GIC's operational risk profile. You will bring a data-driven approach across the team's mandate, using analytics and AI/LLM tools to evaluate controls, support third-party and outsourcing risk assessments, generate insights, and strengthen the firm's overall risk and control environment.

What will you do as an AVP/VP in ORM?
Develop and maintain dashboards and data analytics capability to meet the team's risk analysis, monitoring and reporting needs
Analyse and interpret large data sets to identify risks, control gaps, trends and thematic issues, and translate findings into actionable recommendations
Apply data analytics to enhance control assurance and testing (e.g. automating test procedures, running full-population testing on raw transactional data in place of sampling, and identifying control exceptions and anomalies)
Support third-party and outsourcing due diligence and risk assessments with data-driven analysis (e.g. vendor risk data, concentration analysis, and identification of emerging risks)
Leverage AI/LLM tools to augment risk and control workflows (e.g. reviewing documentation, extracting and summarising key information from contracts and reports, comparing responses against policy requirements to flag gaps, and generating first-cut insights for reviewer refinement)
Track, collate and report key risk indicators (KRIs) and key performance indicators (KPIs) across the team's remit, and analyse trends to flag emerging risks and control weaknesses
Monitor and report risk and control outcomes to senior management and GIC's risk governance committees
Contribute to the design and continuous improvement of methodologies, frameworks and supporting tools, including embedding AI/analytics into assessment workflows
Work with risk managers and business stakeholders to embed a rigorous, data-driven approach across the team's activities

What qualifications or skills should you possess in this role?

Must-haves: At least 5 (AVP) and 7 (VP) years' experience in data analytics, business intelligence or a related field
Strong / advanced proficiency in data mining, analysis and visualisation tools (e.g. Databricks, Tableau), and programming languages such as Python and SQL
Practical experience applying AI/LLM tools to analytics or risk work (e.g. document review, summarisation, gap analysis, and workflow automation)

Good to have: Experience in control assurance, control testing, or a related assurance discipline, including familiarity with control frameworks and testing methodologies
Experience in third-party risk management, vendor due diligence or outsourcing risk, including familiarity with due diligence methodologies and risk assessment frameworks
Broader domain knowledge in operational risk, audit or a related risk and controls field

Attributes: Intellectually curious, with a passion for using data and AI to connect the dots and generate insights that translate into value for stakeholders
Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to synthesise diverse information into clear conclusions
Adept at presenting findings in strong, digestible visuals
Forward-thinking and keen to stay current with developments in the risk, analytics and AI space
Excellent interpersonal, communication and presentation skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally across business areas and seniority levels
Strong organisational and project management skills

Work at the Point of Impact

We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.

Flexibility at GIC

At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration, but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.

GIC is an equal opportunity employer

As an employer, we passionately believe every individual brings with them unique diversity of thought and perspectives to meaningfully enrich perspectives of GIC teams to drive competitive performance. An inclusive environment yields exceptional contribution.

Please email grphrodtaops@gic.com.sg at any point of the application or interview process if adjustments need to be made due to a disability.

new_jobs.description:
GIC is one of the world's largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 offices around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world's industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we Work at the Point of Impact for Singapore's financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide.

Portfolio Execution & Solutions Group

We have teams in Singapore, London and New York, and we provide a full spectrum of services for the Total Portfolio. These include trading and structured advisory, funding and liquidity management, securities lending, beta management, portfolio rebalancing, applied quantitative research, and counterparty relationship management. We also deliver systematic portfolio solutions and innovation, such as portfolio construction techniques and tail-risk management, to strengthen total portfolio construction and resilience.

Portfolio Exposure & Liquidity

You will be part of a team that manages a unified balance sheet, liquidity, financing and rebalancing. The team comprises Treasury, Securities Finance, Beta Management and the new Exposure & Liquidity Research.

About the role

Exposure & Liquidity Research (ELR) is responsible for building the research capabilities, investment models, and decision analytics for Portfolio Managers within the Portfolio Exposure & Liquidity (PEL) division. Our work directly supports the centralised implementation of Total Portfolio requirements across Treasury, Securities Finance, and Beta Management activities to achieve optimal outcomes for GIC.

We are hiring a Quantitative Research Analyst to contribute towards advancing ELR's research agenda, spanning topics such as Total Portfolio liquidity and financing, rebalancing, securities lending and collateral optimisation, and beta and exposure delivery. As part of a global team, you will contribute quantitative insights to add value to PEL's investment process, platform, and business capabilities.

The role is suited to a quantitative profile who thrives on integrating rigorous data analysis with market intuition to drive robust decision-making and optimal portfolio outcomes.

What you will do
Develop quantitative tools and analytics to strengthen GIC's liquidity management capabilities, deepen liquidity and collateral risk management practices, and enhance decision-making and value creation from portfolio implementation activities.
Propose research ideas, formulate hypotheses, and conduct data-driven analysis to optimise delivery of the GIC Portfolio's implementation requirements across cash and derivative instruments.
Contribute to research process design, documentation, and continuous improvement and platforming of the team's quantitative toolkit, while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture .
Partner with portfolio managers to translate research findings into practical implementation choices and repeatable investment decisions
For senior candidates: mentor junior Quantitative Research Analysts, shape the research agenda, and set expectations for excellence in quantitative research, advisory and solutioning across the broader department.

What you need
8+ years of relevant quantitative-focused experience in a Treasury/markets financing function or Prime Brokerage/Financial Resource Management role . A degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics or physics, statistics, computer science, finance, or a related field.
Strong Python skills, statistical modelling, back-testing, portfolio construction and optimisation, and comfort working with large financial datasets. Candidates with a track record of implementation would be highly desirable.
Market knowledge in relevant areas such as asset and liability management (ALM) and liquidity risk concepts, financing products and instruments, margin/collateral risk, short-term interest rate (STIR) and FX funding risk.
Strong communication skills and the ability to explain quantitative work clearly to a non-technical audience including team members, partners and stakeholders.
Effective interpersonal skills; able to build partnerships and good working relationships to enhance business impact and outcomes.
Experience with liquidity risk analytics, collateral and margin optimisation, or AI-assisted research or development tools are highly desired.

Work at the Point of Impact

We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact. .

Flexibility at GIC

At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration, but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.

GIC is an equal opportunity employer

As an employer, we passionately believe every individual brings with them unique diversity of thought and perspectives to meaningfully enrich perspectives of GIC teams to drive competitive performance. An inclusive environment yields exceptional contribution.

new_jobs.title: Beleidsadviseur/project manager Strategy & International Relations (ADSB, 32-40 uur)
new_jobs.description:
Ben jij klaar voor een nieuwe uitdaging binnen een dynamische, internationale omgeving waar politiek, bedrijfsleven en financiële wereld elkaar ontmoeten? Atradius Dutch State Business zoekt voor het team Strategy & International Relations een analytische en verbindende beleidsadviseur/projectmanager. In deze functie combineer je inhoudelijke beleidsontwikkeling met stevig projectmanagement en werk je aan nationale en internationale vraagstukken die direct relevant zijn voor de Nederlandse exportsector.

Over Atradius Dutch State Business

Atradius DSB, onderdeel van de Atradius groep, voert de exportkredietverzekeringsfaciliteit (ekv) uit en biedt namens de Nederlandse staat verzekerings- en garantieproducten aan voor betalingsrisico’s bij zakendoen in het buitenland. Onze klanten zijn Nederlandse exporteurs van kapitaalgoederen of diensten, investeerders, aannemingsbedrijven en hun financiers. Naast traditionele export ondersteunen we ook de bredere internationalisatie van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven met onze producten.

Je werkt in het team Strategy & International Relations. Dit multidisciplinaire team stuurt het strategieproces aan op basis van nationale prioriteiten en internationale ontwikkelingen, adviseert de Nederlandse staat bij EU- en OESO-onderhandelingen en onderhoudt relaties met onder meer andere exportkredietverzekeraars en de Berner Unie (een internationaal netwerk van verzekeraars). We werken nauw samen met onze opdrachtgevers, de ministeries van Financiën en Buitenlandse Zaken, en met collega’s binnen Atradius DSB aan strategische beleidsvraagstukken.

Wat ga je doen?

In deze mediorfunctie ontwikkel en implementeer je beleid op het snijvlak van publieke belangen, internationale economische vraagstukken en de uitvoering van de ekv. Hierbij combineer je projectmanagement met een inhoudelijke bijdrage. Je stuurt het proces aan, verdiept je in de dossiers en brengt de kennis en inzichten van collega’s en betrokken partijen samen. Daarbij analyseer je belangen en ontwikkelingen, vorm je een onderbouwd oordeel en vertaal je dit samen met collega’s naar concrete beleidsvoorstellen en uitvoerbare oplossingen.

Je trekt zelfstandig beleidsprojecten van begin tot eind. Dit zijn je belangrijkste taken:

Projectmanagement: je stelt een aanpak en planning op, coördineert multidisciplinaire projectteams, bewaakt voortgang en kwaliteit, rapporteert over resultaten en zorgt voor tijdige besluitvorming en implementatie.
Nationale beleidscoördinatie: je draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van het Nederlandse beleid voor de ekv in samenwerking met de ministeries van Financiën en Buitenlandse Zaken en collega’s. Op specifieke dossiers coördineer je de afstemming en werk je beleidsvoorstellen uit, met oog voor de belangen van onder meer exporteurs en financiers. Je werkt aan beleidsontwikkeling en executie van strategische onderwerpen zoals transparantie, anti-fraude, vergroening en andere prioritaire vraagstukken binnen de ekv. Afhankelijk van de agenda pak je in overleg zelfstandig nieuwe thema’s op.
Internationale dossiers: je ondersteunt senior adviseurs bij de voorbereiding en opvolging van internationale overleggen binnen bestaande gremia zoals de EU-, OESO- en de Berne Union. Waar gepast neem je ook zelf deel aan deze overleggen. Je coördineert surveys en internationale rapportageverplichtingen. Je draagt bij aan de formulering van jaarplannen, bereidt Nederlandse standpunten en internationale overleggen voor, en coördineert hierin dossiers met collega’s en de Staat. Je volgt internationale ontwikkelingen, beoordeelt de betekenis daarvan voor de Nederlandse ekv en helpt deze te vertalen naar beleid en uitvoering. Op eigen dossiers vertegenwoordig je, in afstemming met senior collega’s en de Staat, mede de Nederlandse standpunten in internationale gremia.
Stakeholdermanagement: je brengt partijen met verschillende belangen bij elkaar, bouwt duurzame werkrelaties op en creëert draagvlak, ook wanneer je geen hiërarchische verantwoordelijkheid hebt.

Jouw Profiel

Je hebt een afgeronde hbo- of universitaire opleiding en 2-5 jaar relevante werkervaring, bijvoorbeeld in een beleidsfunctie, consultancy, financiële dienstverlening, een overheidsorganisatie of een internationale omgeving.
Beleidsmatig en projectmanagement: je combineert inhoudelijke beleidsvaardigheid met aantoonbare ervaring in het zelfstandig organiseren en leiden van projecten. Je kunt schakelen tussen analyse, afstemming, besluitvorming en implementatie.
Je bent analytisch en omgevingsbewust: je maakt je nieuwe dossiers snel eigen, overziet verschillende belangen en begrijpt hoe politieke, economische en uitvoeringsaspecten elkaar beïnvloeden.
Je bent sterk in schrijven en communiceren: je schrijft heldere en overtuigende adviezen en kunt complexe onderwerpen begrijpelijk uitleggen. Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
Verbindend en resultaatgericht: je brengt gemakkelijk verschillende partijen bij elkaar, neemt eigenaarschap en weet projecten vooruit te brengen zonder formele autoriteit. Affiniteit met publiek beleid, internationale economische vraagstukken, exportfinanciering en/of financiële dienstverlening is belangrijk; kennis van het Nederlandse publieke handelsinstrumentarium is een pré.

Wat bieden wij?

Bij Atradius kun je rekenen op een leuke en uitdagende plek om te werken: internationaal, dynamisch en informeel. We bevinden ons in een strategische transitie gericht op het stimuleren van verduurzaming van de Nederlandse export en investeringen in het buitenland. Met de Nederlandse staat als opdrachtgever werken we vaak aan projecten met een maatschappelijke invalshoek. Dit biedt een interessante mix tussen het leveren van een bedrijfseconomische en sociaal-maatschappelijke bijdrage. We vinden het belangrijk onze mensen een omgeving te bieden waarin ze persoonlijke groei kunnen realiseren. Atradius biedt aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden waaronder een marktconform salaris, 13e maand, variabele beloning, goede pensioenregeling en een hybride werkomgeving.

Gelijke kansen voor iedereen

Het succes van onze organisatie staat of valt met de kwaliteit van onze mensen en de ideeën die zij hebben. Echt verrassende inzichten en innovatieve oplossingen voor onze klanten ontstaan door een samenspel van culturen, kennis en ervaring. Daarom is diversiteit voor onze organisatie ontzettend belangrijk. Om ervoor te zorgen dat alle collega’s binnen Atradius DSB hun kwaliteiten kunnen ontplooien, stimuleren we een diverse en inclusieve cultuur waarin iedereen zich betrokken en gewaardeerd voelt. Kandidaten die bijdragen aan die diversiteit worden dan ook van harte uitgenodigd te reageren. 

Enthousiast en wil je solliciteren?

Dat kan via onderstaande button! 

Atradius is een wereldwijde aanbieder van kredietverzekeringen, borgstellingen en garanties, incassodiensten en informatiediensten, met een strategische aanwezigheid in meer dan 50 landen. De producten van Atradius beschermen bedrijven over de hele wereld tegen het risico van wanbetaling dat samenhangt met de verkoop van goederen en diensten op krediet. Atradius maakt deel uit van Grupo Catalana Occidente (GCO.MC), een van de grootste verzekeraars in Spanje en een van de grootste kredietverzekeraars ter wereld.

new_jobs.title: Audit Project Manager - Banking Products
new_jobs.description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

Job Description

The CAS Audit Project Manager is primarily responsible for completing internal audit engagement assignments with minimal supervision from audit team management. The Audit Project Manager is expected to understand risk and risk management techniques, identify and analyze business processes, key risks and critical controls, and evaluate control design adequacy; perform or supervise control testing; and document work performed in conformance with internal audit policies and procedures. This individual may also be involved in other side projects, department initiatives, and other administrative audit activities. The ideal candidate has internal audit experience in the financial services industry of areas including Consumer and Business Banking, Corporate and Commercial, and Capital Markets.

The primary focus of this role over the next 36 months includes completing annual key SOX financial statement control testing for internal audit and other audit support work specific to Banking Products. Internal audit performs SOX testing on behalf of management to ensure strong reliance by external auditors. The role may directly or indirectly lead team members.

Key accountabilities:

Performing control testing and/or supervising staff auditors performing control testing based on audit program directions. Includes using appropriate sampling and control testing techniques; identifying and assessing the relevance of possible issues; and documenting work performed to support audit scope and conclusions, to facilitate an efficient review, and to meet internal audit policies and procedures.
Drafting audit issues under the supervision of audit team management. Includes drafting potential exposures and significance, identifying appropriate root causes, and developing operationally effective and cost-effective recommendations.
Assisting audit team management in the reporting and wrap-up phases of audits. Includes assisting with drafting audit reports.
Learning from and applying coaching received.
Serving as a subject matter expert in a particular topic, helping drive strategy, and may support multiple audit engagements covering the related topics.
Handling complex tasks autonomously and being able to influence business line understanding of risk mitigation.
Performing other duties as requested by audit team management.
Assisting audit team management in planning audit engagements. Includes understanding risk and risk management techniques; identifying and analyzing business processes, key risks, and critical controls; interviewing auditees; and evaluating control design adequacy.
Providing coaching and on-the-job training for team members, as applicable, to ensure engagements are completed in conformance with internal audit policies and procedures.
Partnering with the assigned line of business, other Risk/Compliance/Audit (RCA) professionals and managers, and RCA Managers to, depending on their function, create, implement, maintain, review or oversee an effective risk management framework.
Participating in projects and/or activities ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations.
Identifying gaps and informing solutions that minimize losses resulting from inadequate internal processes, systems, or human errors.
Identifying, responding to, or escalating risks, as appropriate.

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
Typically 6+ years of applicable experience

Preferred Skills and Experience:

Advanced financial services industry knowledge relevant to Banking Products including Consumer and Business Banking (e.g., retail, business banking, mortgage, etc.), Corporate and Commercial Banking, and Capital Markets.
Relevant Capital Markets product knowledge, including derivatives, foreign exchange, fixed income, and municipal products.
Relevant knowledge of laws and regulations applicable to securities and derivatives, including Swap Dealer requirements, the Market Risk Rule, FINRA, MSRB, and the Volcker Rule.
Relevant mortgage product knowledge including knowledge of laws and regulations applicable to mortgage originations, i.e., the Real Estate Settlement Procedures Act (RESPA) and Truth in Lending Act (TILA).
Applicable professional certifications or credentials, such as CIA, CPA, CFSA (Certified Financial Services Auditor), CRCM (Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager), FINRA licenses, CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst), CIDA (Certified Investments & Derivatives Auditor), another relevant professional designation, or an advanced degree.
Relevant internal audit experience in the financial services industry in areas including SOX, regulatory compliance, and risk management.
Considerable knowledge of applicable laws, regulations, financial services, and regulatory trends that impact Banking Products.
Considerable understanding of Banking Product’s operations, products and services, systems, and associated risks and controls.
Considerable knowledge of Risk/Compliance/Audit competencies and the ability to hold others accountable on individual projects.
Advanced process facilitation, project management, and analytical skills for complex processes.
Thorough understanding of The Institute of Internal Auditors’ Global Internal Audit Standards and the common definition of internal controls.
Business acumen and credibility to help business lines proactively identify and address the evolving risk landscape and changing workforce needs.
Excellent presentation, interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.
Strong critical thinking and analytical skills.
Proven adaptability to changing priorities and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously.
Ability to successfully coordinate with multiple groups to complete projects.
Proficient computer navigation skills using a variety of software packages, including Microsoft applications.
