new_jobs.title: Platform Infrastructure Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

I&O Platform Infrastructure Data Analyst

The opportunity

In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology we are looking for a skilled Infrastructure Data Analyst to support and evolve EY's I&O data analytics and reporting capabilities globally. This is a unique role that bridges deep data analysis with practical infrastructure knowledge, enabling the firm to transform operational data from across its data center, compute, network, storage and observability platforms into actionable intelligence.

A key focus of this role is providing the analytical intelligence layer for the Hyperconverged Service Platform (HCSP) — EY's next-generation infrastructure automation platform built on Kubernetes, Temporal and Terraform. The Data Analyst will own the measurement, reporting and continuous improvement analysis of HCSP's provisioning performance, workflow reliability, SLA attainment, drift detection efficacy and operational impact across EY's global data center estate — directly enabling the platform team to measure success, identify failure patterns and demonstrate value.

Your Key Responsibilities

The I&O Platform Infrastructure Data Analyst collects, processes and analyzes operational data from across EY's infrastructure platforms — with a particular focus on HCSP platform telemetry — transforming raw data from workflow orchestration systems, provisioning engines, log aggregation platforms, ITSM tools and capacity management systems into meaningful insights and visualizations.

The role requires a strong analytical skill set combined with sufficient infrastructure and platform automation awareness to understand the context of the data being analyzed. The analyst will serve as the analytical authority for HCSP KPI reporting — tracking metrics such as provisioning SLA attainment, orchestrator failure rates, manual touchpoint reduction, rollback success rates and catalog drift elimination — and will partner with the HCSP engineering team, I&O leadership and service management to drive a data-informed culture of continuous platform improvement.

Skills And Attributes For Success

Strong experience designing and delivering data analytics solutions using Power BI, including complex DAX measures, data models and report publishing.
Proficiency querying and analyzing data from ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) including KQL query development and Kibana dashboard creation.
Experience working with large, multi-source operational datasets and transforming them into executive and operational reporting.
Ability to analyze and report on platform automation data, including:
Workflow execution metrics
OPA policy evaluation outcomes and policy compliance trends
Drift detection signals
ServiceNow order intake volumes, ticket correlation

Good understanding of data center infrastructure technologies including:
Windows Server and Linux operating system fundamentals
Virtualization platforms — Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware
Kubernetes cluster concepts — pods, namespaces, workloads and resource utilization
Network fundamentals — VLANs, DNS, IP management
Storage and compute provisioning concepts

Experience with SQL or KQL for querying structured and semi-structured data sources.
Experience integrating data from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow or equivalent) into analytical reporting.
Familiarity with APM and monitoring tooling (Dynatrace, SolarWinds, Prometheus or equivalent) as data sources.
Experience with ETL/ELT pipelines and data ingestion from multiple infrastructure and platform data sources.
Scripting capability to automate data extraction and transformation tasks:
Python (pandas, NumPy, requests)
PowerShell
Bash

Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to present HCSP performance findings and SLA trend analysis to both technical and senior business audiences.
Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks.
Ability to work effectively with global engineering and service management teams across multiple time zones.

To qualify for the role, you must have experience with

Power BI report and dashboard development — 5–7 years.
Power BI data modelling, DAX development and Power Query (M) transformations — 5–7 years.
ELK stack data analysis — Elasticsearch queries and Kibana dashboard development — 3–5 years.
SQL data analysis and querying against operational data stores — 5–7 years.
KPI definition, metric design and SLA/OLA reporting for platform or infrastructure services.
Data integration from ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, Remedy or equivalent).
Working with infrastructure and platform automation monitoring data — metrics, logs, workflow events and traces.
Building capacity planning and trend analysis reports for infrastructure and automation platforms.
Kubernetes and container platform telemetry consumption and analysis.
Workflow orchestration data analysis — Temporal, Argo or equivalent execution logs and metrics.
OPA policy evaluation data analysis and compliance reporting.
Drift detection and configuration audit data analysis.
Windows Server and Linux operating system concepts — sufficient to contextualize infrastructure data.
Virtualization platform familiarity (Nutanix AHV, Hyper-V, VMware vSphere or Azure Stack HCI).
Python scripting for data extraction, transformation and automation — 3–5 years.
PowerShell scripting for Windows infrastructure data collection.
Executive reporting and stakeholder presentation delivery.
Azure Monitor, Log Analytics or equivalent cloud observability data sources (preferred).
Working with CMDB data to enrich infrastructure and platform analytics (preferred).

Ideally, you'll also have

Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) certification (desired).
Elastic Certified Analyst certification (desired).
Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900) or Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) (better to have).
ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary).
Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics or Databricks (better to have).
Experience with Grafana or similar open-source visualization platforms.
Familiarity with OpenTelemetry (OTel) as a telemetry standard for HCSP platform automation data.
Experience analyzing data from Temporal.io workflow execution APIs or audit logs.
Experience with Terraform state data and infrastructure drift analysis.
Experience operating within a managed services or large enterprise shared services environment.

What We Look For

A data-driven professional with a genuine curiosity for infrastructure platform operations and a talent for turning complex, multi-source operational data into clear and actionable insight. We are looking for an individual who combines strong analytical and visualization skills with practical infrastructure and platform automation awareness — enabling them to serve as the trusted analytical partner to EY's HCSP engineering team and I&O leadership, measuring the platform's impact, identifying improvement opportunities and demonstrating the value of automation at scale.

What We Offer

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you'll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development. Plus, we offer:

Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

The IS team seeks to hire a highly committed candidate to build and expand our multidimensional programmes across a range of technical and policy areas. This role demands high-quality research to provide direction, support, and insights to policy planners and industry captains on decarbonisation options. The candidate should have an active and self-directed interest towards the assessment of alternative fuels, including green hydrogen and derivatives, CCUS, industrial decarbonisation and other related sectors. The candidate should have excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to make detailed presentations to various stakeholders and write informative reports. The candidate should demonstrate the ability to work with different colleagues, manage multiple priorities, be detail-oriented, and adhere to timelines. In addition to the duties and responsibilities below, the individual should be prepared to take on additional responsibilities as and when necessary.

Job duties and accountabilities

Take ownership of at least two research topics in the industrial sustainability and green hydrogen sector pertaining to energy systems modelling and techno-economic assessment.
Write high-quality first drafts of reports and analyses for internal and external circulation.
Generate knowledge content – at least two reports or policy briefs in a year.
Drive daily analytical requirements of the team in responding to short-turnaround requests.
Support the team’s policy engagements with central and state government departments through research and data analysis and by preparing reports and presentations.
Support stakeholder engagement and relevant convening, including policy and technical exchanges among government officials, R&D facilities, subject experts, etc.
Present research to key constituencies, advisory bodies, conferences & research institutes.
Develop research networks locally, nationally and internationally in support of research programmes.

Experience and expertise in creating techno-economic models using Excel and other software packages

Knowledge of the energy landscape in India across various sectors and the policy techniques that can be leveraged to bring about change is a plus point.

Strong analytic skills, including quantitative research methods and tools that are fit for purpose.
Excellent oral and written communication skills in English

Strong project management skills. Confidence in handling tasks and engaging with stakeholders single-handedly would be highly preferred for Programme Associates.

Military Spouse Preference applicants will be placed at the highest grade for which they have applied and are determined Best Qualified (BQ). A BQ military spouse possesses knowledge, skills, abilities, and competencies comparable to others who meet the competitive referral criteria for the specific position.

PPP applicants will be placed at the FPL, if determined Well Qualified (WQ). To receive priority consideration, the FPL must be the same grade level or equivalent of the retained grade or the grade held immediately prior to separation.

Certain incentives (such as Recruitment, Relocation or Student Loan Repayment) may be authorized to eligible selectees.

A relocation incentive is generally a single payment intended to offset some of the relocation costs experienced by the selectee. A relocation incentive may be authorized.

new_jobs.description:
About Us

At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space.

We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action.

What You'll Do

The Space Infrastructure organization is responsible for delivering advanced space systems that enable mission success for government and commercial customers. As a Program Manager, Spacecraft Development, you will be responsible for the successful execution of spacecraft development activities from concept through delivery, ensuring that technical, schedule, cost, quality, and business objectives are achieved.

You will lead the day-to-day execution of a complex spacecraft development effort, coordinating activities across engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, integration & test, mission assurance, finance, and business operations. Working closely with technical leadership, you will ensure that program plans remain aligned with requirements, resources, risks, customer expectations, and company objectives.

This role requires strong leadership, organizational skills, business acumen, and the ability to drive execution across highly matrixed teams. Success depends on maintaining clear priorities, establishing accountability, managing risk, and ensuring that decisions are made quickly and effectively to keep programs on track.

The day-to-day

Own day-to-day execution of spacecraft development programs, ensuring alignment to approved scope, cost, schedule, and technical objectives.
Develop and maintain integrated program plans, schedules, resource forecasts, budgets, and execution roadmaps.
Coordinate activities across engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, integration & test, mission assurance, finance, and business operations teams.
Track program progress against key milestones and performance objectives, identifying risks and issues early and driving resolution to closure.
Establish and maintain execution metrics, dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to provide visibility into program health.
Facilitate cross-functional planning, prioritization, and decision-making activities.
Lead recurring program reviews, schedule reviews, risk reviews, action-item reviews, and management briefings.
Manage program risks, dependencies, opportunities, assumptions, and mitigation plans.
Support supplier and subcontractor coordination activities, ensuring external deliverables remain aligned with program needs.
Partner with technical leadership to evaluate trade-offs involving scope, performance, cost, schedule, resources, and risk.
Manage program changes, baseline updates, and execution impacts associated with evolving requirements or business priorities.
Drive accountability across stakeholders to ensure commitments are met and program objectives remain on track.
Prepare and present program status, recovery plans, forecasts, and key decisions to program and organizational leadership.
Support customer reviews, contractual milestones, and executive-level communications.
Identify opportunities to improve program execution processes, planning methods, reporting practices, and team effectiveness.

What You'll Need

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Business, Program Management, or a related discipline.
Deep experience leading complex technical development programs in aerospace, defense, satellite, telecommunications, or other highly engineered industries.
Demonstrated experience managing scope, schedule, cost, resources, risks, and stakeholder communications within a multidisciplinary environment.
Experience coordinating cross-functional teams across engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, quality, and operations organizations.
Strong understanding of product development lifecycles, systems engineering processes, and hardware development programs.
Experience building and maintaining integrated schedules, resource plans, and program forecasts.
Experience facilitating technical and business decision-making among diverse stakeholder groups.
Strong communication, organization, presentation, and leadership skills.
Ability to influence teams and drive execution in matrixed organizations without direct authority.

What Will Help You On The Job

Experience supporting spacecraft, payload, satellite communications, launch vehicle, or other complex aerospace programs.
Experience working with government and commercial customers.
Experience using Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, Smartsheet, Jira, or similar program management tools.
Experience with Earned Value Management (EVM) and program performance measurement.

PMP certification or equivalent project/program management certification.
Experience supporting supplier management, subcontract execution, and hardware procurement activities.
Experience leading program reviews including SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, and readiness reviews.
Master's degree in Engineering, Systems Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field

Our professional services client is looking for a senior Technical Business Analyst for its post-quantum cryptography (PQC) readiness programme. The strategy is already agreed. You'll work with the senior project manager, the PQC technical lead and the strategy team. Your job is to turn technical direction into clear requirements, processes and delivery plans. Keeping requirements, risks, decisions and dependencies traceable end to end, and producing reporting ready for executives

Experience working with architecture, cyber security, engineering, infrastructure or technology risk teams

The ability to bring structure and pace to ambiguous, emerging areas
